programme.title: Damilola: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Twenty-six years after the murder of 10-year-old Damilola Taylor shocked Britain, this documentary examines his story with new testimony that sheds fresh light on what happened. Actor John Boyega, who was eight when Damilola died and was one of the last people to see him alive, joins Damilola's childhood friends to return to his final months and the years of youth violence that followed his death

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors
programme.desc: As the players go deeper into the game, a new day brings new suspicions amongst the faithful. The mission forces the celebrities to work in teams under terrifying conditions, and with the murdering hour approaching, the players take their seats at the round table

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
programme.desc: Ed Gamble will be joined by celebrities and players to analyse and react to developments in the castle

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: City-dwelling families, couples and individuals set out to find their ideal rural retreats with the help of a property expert

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: An intrepid team of four friends competes for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: The Reluctant Vampire
programme.desc: Val has to come up with a plan to pass the vampire initiation ceremony despite his huge secret. However, his curiosity about human life gets the better of him, and he sneaks to the village, where he bumps into Gertie and is thrust straight into human family life. His two worlds collide when he's invited to a party

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek Brockway explores what lies beneath his feet when he revisits Great Orme, Offa's Dyke Path and the last surviving cast iron footbridge in Merthyr Tydfil

programme.title: BBC News

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc:
Game show presented by Rick Edwards in which players score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face the Final Run and earn the opportunity to take home their cash prize

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Susan Calman in which one contestant becomes the Boss and has to use judgement and tactics to decide which player is best suited to answer questions

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo's railway journey through Cumbria and Dumfriesshire heads to the hills as he follows in the footsteps of the Lakeland poets. In Keswick, he retraces the walks of Samuel Taylor Coleridge, discovering how one of his legendary routes has been used as a form of therapy. Michael also visits the ruins of Lowther Castle, once a grand gothic estate, now reborn as a garden

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Siobhan, her partner Timmie and their two young children hope to bring new life in Butlerstown, Co Cork, by renovating the old post office to become their forever home

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Witley Court in Worcestershire, where they discover an early puppet theatre, a Worcester plate made as a royal gift and a drawing by Salford artist LS Lowry. They also value a rare piece of early Staffordshire slipware, similar to the famous 'Ozzie the Owl'. First broadcast in 2004

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team value antiques at the Discovery Museum in Newcastle. Experts Anita Manning and Nick Davies examine hundreds of collectibles brought along by members of the public, and Paul learns about the landscape gardener Capability Brown

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Chizzy Akudolu, Stephen Bailey, Banjo Beale and Philippa Dunne test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor returns with some training room exclusives, with a look at how some of the celebrities are getting on with their next dances. Also, a panel of Strictly pros pop by to reveal some dance secrets

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedians Lloyd Griffith and Rhys James face off in a battle of antiques while on a road trip around Wales and south west England. They're joined by jewellery pro Hettie Jago and coin specialist Tim Medhurst. In Pontypool, Rhys makes an unusual find in the form of a picture frame-cum-radio and in Monmouth, Lloyd uncovers a sporting score board

programme.title: Secrets and Spies: A Nuclear Game
programme.desc: The documentary looks at how Britain identified Mikhail Gorbachev as a possible new contender for Soviet leader, believing he could be the ticket to better relations between East and West. Plus, how fragile steps towards diplomacy were threatened by the vested interests of other spies still stuck in the old world order

programme.title: The Book That Changed My Life
programme.desc: Inspired by her passion to get people reading, Queen Camilla joins four remarkable people to share the stories of books that shaped them. Warm, emotional and full of hope, the programme shows how reading can lift people up, open minds and even change lives in a celebration of the power inside every book

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: Iain Stirling introduces comedians Harriet Dyer and Maria Shehata to the London's Hammersmith Apollo stage, where they perform their stand-up routines

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Victoria Derbyshire

programme.title: Unspun World with John Simpson
programme.desc: The BBC's world affairs editor reflects on the week's major global news stories, talking to local experts from around the world to go behind the headlines

programme.title: John Simpson - Sixty Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson takes a look back at his 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global news stories of the era. He reflects on the changing world he has witnessed, including the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, and the fall of the Berlin Wall. John also reminisces on memorable encounters with inspiring leaders and cruel dictators

programme.title: Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga
programme.desc: Part one of two. David meets the historians who have built the Register of British Slave Traders, piecing together a comprehensive picture of more than 13,000 individuals who were investors in the slave trade, showing the links between modern British institutions and the trade in human beings. He begins by revealing how the monarchy drove the early British slave trade, with Elizabeth I and the early Stuarts giving their support to early slavery ventures

programme.title: Matthew's Story: Stand Up to Cancer
programme.desc: The story of Matthew, who in 2023 was diagnosed with an aggressive brain tumour, reflecting on the way the ilness brought his family closer together

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to Murphy's Historic Hotel near Sacramento in northern California, where owners Brian, Kevin and Joel are often too distracted by their lively bar to look after their business. The national landmark, which has played host to an array of famous names including Mark Twain, President Ulysses S Grant and JP Morgan, has no dedicated accommodation manager, so guests sometimes struggle to receive the attention they need and end up feeling the hotel has become an afterthought beside the noisy saloon

programme.title: Apocalypse
programme.desc: A new survivor arrives at the West camp seeking shelter, and notices a gender divide in the West, with the women sidelined, so urges Kelly and Celia to make a stand. When a box of cereal is divided up unequally between the men and the women, a huge confrontation crackles, and then pops. A supply drop leads to a dawn race while Bertie's attempt to create some creature comforts leads to an internal feud

programme.desc: The chef continues his 'journey without maps', leaving the main routes and tourist hotspots behind to embark on a personal road trip along picturesque and remote backroads. Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.

Richard, Kath and Dobbin are all members of their local amateur dramatic club and have been since the 1960s. Dobbin even made a cameo appearance at their wedding ceremony. Although Kath has tried unsuccessfully to repair his various issues, he is falling apart and in no fit state to tread the boards.
And stringed instrument expert Julyan Wallis takes on a much-loved dreadnought guitar in a diabolical condition. Owner Walter Renton played professionally in various bands in his heyday and wooed his wife with love songs played on this very instrument. His daughter Ann is immensely proud of him and not just for his musical talent. Recently Walter has been very poorly but is now well on the road to recovery. Being able to play his old guitar, that he bought over 50 years ago, would give him and his loving family hope for the future.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Today, Andrew Denly and wife Sheila from Sussex are hoping clockmaker Steve Fletcher can fix a vintage boy's toy with big memories attached. It's an antique toy cannon handed down to Andrew by his grandfather, who bought it with his pocket money in 1907. Andrew fondly describes his grandfather as his inspiration and boyhood hero. The little cannon is much treasured but hasn't worked in over 50 years. Steve must use all his ingenuity to get it firing once more.
A Victorian oddity is brought to the attention of leather expert Susie Fletcher. Sisters Pam and Frances are hoping Suzie can revive a novelty inkwell in the shape of a hat. It is a treasured family heirloom as it had huge sentimental value to the sisters' mother. After years of vigorous overuse, the button mechanism no longer works and it is missing its leather covering. Suzie drafts in sibling Steve Fletcher to help make a missing part, and she discovers a new talent for miniature millinery as she returns the inkwell to its stylish former glory.
Finally, ceramics expert Kirstin Ramsey prays for divine intervention as she tries to rebuild a saintly statue. Caroline Morson and Professor John Northover have come to the barn seeking help resurrecting an important icon that's been a symbol of hope to many: a statue of St Fiacre, the patron saint of gardeners and haemorrhoid victims! The statue has been a landmark in the garden of St Mark's Hospital, a centre for the treatment of bowel disease, for many years, but has been vandalised and is now broken in two. Gifted to the hospital by Caroline's father, renowned pathologist Dr Basil Morson, staff and patients alike are keen to see St Fiacre restored and back on duty. By far one of the biggest projects Kirsten has had on her bench, she must clean and reunite the two large broken halves, creating an imperceptible join to breathe new life into this old saint.

The experts head to Dirleton Castle in East Lothian to reveal the role one of the men played in defending England from William Wallace's army, and also try their hands at the art of stained glass-making, and fire a working trebuchet - the ultimate medieval weapon of war

programme.title: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild
programme.desc: Ben journeys to Spain to meet 50-year-old free spirit Nara, who has spent most of his adult life without modern conveniences like shoes, toothbrushes and flushing toilets. Nara introduces Ben to his unique lifestyle, in which he moves between intentional communities. Through their conversations, Ben learns how his eccentric host's unconventional childhood shaped his distinctive outlook on life

programme.title: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild
programme.desc: Ben journeys to an off-grid home in the forests of Canton, Maine, where he meets Arthur, a hunter-gatherer with a PhD in botany, along with his two daughters, Samara and Fera, and his girlfriend Kelly. During his stay, Ben witnesses how Arthur's ideology is passed down to his daughters. Samara impresses with her bow and arrow skills, hunting from a height, while young Fera demonstrates her ability to husk rice

programme.title: 7 Wonders of the World with Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The historian travels across three continents as she follows in the footsteps of warriors, pilgrims, emperors and tourists by visiting the sites of the most notable structures of antiquity. She begins her journey in Egypt at the Great Pyramid of Giza, with cutting-edge graphics showing it in its original, glistening glory, before sailing up the Nile to Alexandria, site of the legendary Pharos lighthouse

programme.title: 7 Wonders of the World with Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: The historian heads to Greece to explore the stories behind two sculpted wonders of the ancient world. In Rhodes, she uncovers how the materials for the Colossus of Rhodes were sourced and meets local sculptor Kostas Neofitou, who demonstrates the techniques that could have been used to build it. Bettany then sails for mainland Greece to investigate the Statue of Zeus at Olympia, walking through the ruins of the temple where the awe-inspiring statue once stood, and vividly brings the sculpture to life using graphic reconstructions

programme.title: Prisoner: Cell Block H
programme.desc: Locked down in their cells, the women try to figure out the significance of the gunfire.

programme.title: Prisoner: Cell Block H
programme.desc: Erica warns Doreen that if her story is true, she could be charged.

programme.title: Silent War: The Shadow of Atomic Bombs
programme.desc: Part one of two. Hiroshima to Kazakhstan - how nuclear powers turned remote lands and marginalised peoples into laboratories of the atomic age, hiding the deadly reality of fallout while perfecting more powerful bombs. It sold the arms race as protection and progress

programme.title: Grand Tours of the Scottish Islands
programme.desc: Paul Murton embarks on his most difficult journey to date as every destination has been long abandoned by people, meaning there are no ferries, piers or proper landing stages. He visits the once-inhabited island of Heisgeir, sails around the gannet haven of Sula Sgeir and endures rough seas to make landfall on the extraordinarily remote island of North Rona

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May journeys across the United States to explore climate tipping points. Discovering how critical climate systems are for the planet’s stability, and learning the science behind these changes

programme.title: Besieged Fortresses, Legendary Battles
programme.desc: The Muslim Ottomans launch an offensive against the island of Rhodes. However, the Hospitallers' military forces settled there are already preparing the defence

programme.title: Edwardian Britain in Colour
programme.desc: Part one of a two-part documentary in which social historians examine surviving film footage of Britain in the early years of the 20th century. The first episode features footage of Queen Victoria's state funeral in 1901 and a bicycle parade celebrating the coronation of the new king. The programme also examines life for people employed in the mining and cotton industries, as well as how an increase in leisure time led to the the popularity of seaside resorts soaring, with Blackpool leading the way

programme.title: Silent War: The Shadow of Atomic Bombs
programme.desc: Part two of two. The hydrogen bomb age from Bikini to Kazakhstan, the closure of the Soviet Polygon and the broken promises of the Budapest Memorandum. Today, Russia uses nuclear threats to redraw borders and China builds its arsenal unchecked

programme.title: China: Treasures of the Jade Empire
programme.desc: A look at the relics found in the tombs of China's Han Dynasty. The era is generally considered the golden age of ancient China, rivalling the Roman empire for international power, and has been a defining influence on the country's cultural identity ever since. The programme examines how the emperors arranged to have their dead bodies mummified in the search for immortality and looks at a newly discovered version of the famous terracotta army

programme.title: Reporting Scotland: News at Seven
programme.desc: Reports from BBC newsrooms across the country with analysis and discussion on the big stories of the day

programme.title: Life on the Bay
programme.desc: A park veteran and resident reveals his passion for bowling at the local club, where he challenges manager Steven to a game. Park warden Neil and his wife Angela's son Josh has applied for a permanent post that comes with a caravan, but there is strong competition from fellow member of the maintenance team Gibby, who is also keen to impress

programme.title: Island Crossings
programme.desc: Windsurfers head to Tiree for the UK's oldest wave sailing contest, a skincare company in Stornoway struggles to get orders away, and a stranded dolphin needs urgent assistance

programme.title: Debate Night
programme.desc: Topical debate on the big issues affecting Scotland and beyond. Members of the public have an hour to put their questions to a panel of politicians and other public figures about the biggest stories and the things they care about the most

programme.title: Dinosaur
programme.desc: Nina promises she won't tell Ranesh what happened on the hen do but when Bo finds out what happened, Evie shares some harsh truths. Lee stops responding to Nina's texts

programme.title: Dinosaur
programme.desc: Evie decides she wants to tell Ranesh the truth just an hour before the wedding and Nina is left with a decision to make when she's offered a job on the Isle of Wight. Lee opens up about why he distanced himself from Nina

programme.title: Scotcast
programme.desc: Discussion on Scotland's biggest news stories, with analysis from journalists, commentators and guests

programme.title: Race Against the Tide
programme.desc: Iain Stirling challenges the five remaining teams to create monsters out of sand, with the duos battling six hours of gale-force winds and the tide to carve their most gruesome creations yet. Sadie Clayton and Jamie Wardley judge the efforts, which take in everything from devilish beasts to twisted clowns as imagination and creativity meets pure endurance

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Nicholas Hoult and Ewan McGregor. Humanity is put on the menu when a farm boy opens the gateway between our world and a fearsome giant race.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The tiny blue forest-dwelling creatures flee from an evil wizard, only to end up magically transported to modern-day New York. They search for a way to get back to their own village while evading their enemy, who has followed them to the Big Apple. Fantasy comedy, with Neil Patrick Harris, Hank Azaria and Jayma Mays, plus voices of Jonathan Winters and Katy Perry

programme.title: The Smurfs 2
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy starring Neil Patrick Harris. After all her friends appear to have forgotten her birthday, Smurfette runs away from the village, only to be snatched through a portal to the real world, by the evil Gargamel. To get her back, the other Smurfs must travel to our world, reuniting with some old friends along the way, before she can give Gargamel the formula to make his own Smurfs. UNCHECKED

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical based on the Broadway hit, starring Quvenzhané Wallis, Cameron Diaz and Jamie Foxx. A foster child's life changes after accidentally meeting a workaholic tycoon running for mayor of New York.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too
programme.desc: Comedy sequel to the blockbuster Look Who's Talking, starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. Mikey is still trying to cope with the trials of potty training when he is presented with another bombshell: he is to get a sister. And, as if that wasn't enough, relations between his parents James and Mollie aren't going so well, either.

programme.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
programme.desc: Comedy. Broadway beckons when the Muppets decide to take their college show, Manhattan Melodies, to New York. However, in the best musical tradition, success doesn't quite happen overnight.

programme.title: Muppets from Space
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy adventure starring the felt friends and featuring guest appearances by F Murray Abraham, Ray Liotta and Andie MacDowell. After discovering that his ancestors might have been aliens, Gonzo finds himself kidnapped by an evil government agent.

programme.title: Casper
programme.desc: Supernatural comedy fantasy starring Christina Ricci, Bill Pullman, Cathy Moriarty and Eric Idle. A wicked heiress hires Dr Harvey, a specialist on ghosts, to rid the haunted house she has inherited of its unwanted inhabitants. But Casper, the nice nephew of nasty ghosts Stretch, Stinkie and Fatso, strikes up a friendship with the doctor's daughter.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure directed by Steven Spielberg, starring Mark Rylance and Ruby Barnhill. London, 1983: ten-year-old Sophie is awake in the middle of the night when she spots a giant from the window of her orphanage home. Although Sophie hides, the 24ft behemoth grabs her and takes the little girl to Giant Country. There she learns he's actually vegetarian and extremely ancient, but he's also as unloved as she is.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan, Kevin Hart and Jack Black. Four high-school students discover a dusty 1990s video game and are sucked into its world as the characters they chose. They soon discover that if they lose their three "lives" in the game, they will be killed in real life. In order to survive, they must complete the game and break its curse.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure sequel starring Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart and Karen Gillan. Two years after the events of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle, the teenagers must return to the magical video game to rescue one of their own. But when they get there, the players are baffled to find that everything about the game - and themselves - has changed.

programme.title: Johnny English
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson, and featuring John Malkovich. When the crown jewels are stolen from under the nose of the authorities, bumbling secret agent Johnny English is assigned to retrieve them and capture the culprits. The unfortunate spy is soon in over his head when he discovers that the theft is part of an evil plan to seize the British throne.

programme.title: Johnny English Reborn
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Rowan Atkinson. When a plot comes to light to assassinate the Chinese premier, hapless operative Johnny English, currently honing his combat skills in a remote region of Tibet, is hurriedly called back to MI7.

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: One Last Shot
programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network. Director James Nunn's thriller, starring Scott Adkins, Steven Cree and Hannah Ware

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: After his son is killed, a father abducts the child responsible, hell-bent on revenge. Writer/Director Evan Ari Kelman's thriller, starring Hamish Linklater, Tramell Tillman and Brittany Snow

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score. Thriller, starring Zachary Levi, Liam Neeson and Quincy Isaiah

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: A young farmer hopes a debutante ball will transform her life. Her city cousin arrives after being expelled from school and scoffs at the traditions. As they search for dates, the teenagers challenge each other's assumptions. Comedy musical, starring Natalie Abbott, Charlotte MacInnes, and Rebel Wilson, who also directed

programme.title: The Moment
programme.desc: A fictionalised version of pop star Charli XCX navigates the complexities of fame and industry pressure while preparing for her arena tour debut. Mockumentary, starring Charli XCX, Rosanna Arquette and Kate Berlant

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: One Last Shot
programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network. Director James Nunn's thriller, starring Scott Adkins, Steven Cree and Hannah Ware

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Bone Lake
programme.desc: A couple's holiday is upended when they're forced to share a mansion with a mysterious couple, spiralling into a maze of sex, lies and manipulation. Comedy thriller, starring Alex Roe and Maddie Hasson

programme.title: 47 Metres Down
programme.desc: Horror thriller starring Mandy Moore and Claire Holt. Two thrill-seeking sisters go on a shark-watching trip, but their adventure turns into a nightmare when their shark-proof cage becomes detached from the boat and plummets to the ocean floor. With their air running out and great whites circling, the women realise they are in big trouble.

programme.title: Rabbit Trap
programme.desc: Married musicians Daphne and Darcy Davenport moved from London to a cottage in Wales to complete their new album. By accident they record a mystical sound never heard before, and gradually disconnect from reality. Writer/director Bryn Chainey's horror, starring Dev Patel and Rosy McEwen

programme.title: The Accursed
programme.desc: A woman named Elly is asked by family friend Alma to look after an elderly lady living in a remote cabin for a few days. She agrees, but soon discovers there is a demon hiding in the woman, waiting to break free. Horror, starring Mena Suvari, Sarah Grey and Meg Foster

programme.title: They Will Kill You
programme.desc: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a New York City high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realises the community is shrouded in mystery. Comedy horror, starring Zazie Beetz, Myha'la, Paterson Joseph and Tom Felton

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Oscar-winning horror mystery starring Daniel Kaluuya and Allison Williams. Chris, a young African-American photographer, is understandably anxious when he's invited to stay with his wealthy white girlfriend's parents at their family estate. Admitting she hasn't told them he's black only adds to Chris's apprehension, but mum and dad are warm and welcoming. However, as the weekend unfolds, Chris begins to suspect all is not as it seems.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: Horror starring Jaeden Lieberher, Bill Skarsgård and Finn Wolfhard. In the summer of 1989, seven misfit children come together to investigate a series of mysterious tragedies in their town, and find themselves facing off against a demon that takes the shape of a terrifying clown.

programme.title: The Lost Boys
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Jason Patric and Kiefer Sutherland. A small town in northern California hides the darkest of secrets. It's a place where a Vampires Everywhere comic could save your life and where, if you are very unlucky, you'll never grow old, you'll never die and you'll always have fresh blood to drink.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East. When young Mormon missionaries Sister Barnes and Sister Paxton visit the house of potential convert Mr Reed, he engages them in religious debate. However, his interest in doctrine takes a menacing turn when he traps them in his house and begins to reveal far darker intentions.

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Sam Raimi's notorious cult horror starring Bruce Campbell. Five friends take shelter in a remote woodland cabin where they discover the Sumerian Book of the Dead and a tape containing mysterious incantations. But when they play the recording, they unwittingly unleash demons that have the power to possess the living.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Bruce Campbell as Ash, whose romantic break in a remote cabin goes terrifyingly wrong when he accidentally unleashes an evil force that possesses his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: Helm Hammerhand sits on the throne of Rohan, flanked by sons Hama and Haleth and rebellious daughter Hera. Dunlending lord Freca proposes a marital union between Hera and his son Wulf, which Helm loudly rejects. In a subsequent brawl between fathers, Helm unintentionally lands a fatal blow, so Wulf vows revenge and amasses an army led by General Targg. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Gaia Wise, Brian Cox, Luke Pasqualino and Lorraine Ashbourne

programme.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
programme.desc: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find a magical object that transports them through time. Lost in a distant era, they must work together to find a way home.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Animated action adventure featuring the voices of Shameik Moore and Jake Johnson. Teenager Miles Morales is bitten by a radioactive arachnid and develops superhuman abilities like those of local hero Spider-Man. When Spidey is taken out of action by villain Kingpin, Miles must step up to prevent an unstable supercollider from sending New York into another dimension. But he soon finds he's not the only spider-being in town...

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Brianna Denski, Jennifer Garner and Mila Kunis. June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scientists!
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman Animations, featuring the voices of Hugh Grant, David Tennant and Martin Freeman. Pirate Captain may be the leader of a shambolic crew of buccaneers but he's still determined to win the coveted Pirate of the Year competition, even if it means fighting off fearsome rivals Black Bellamy, Peg-Leg Hastings and Cutlass Liz to see who can amass the most booty.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voice of Steve Carell. Behind the seemingly tranquil façade of small-town America, super-criminal Gru plots his biggest heist yet: to steal the Moon. But an encounter with orphan sisters Margo, Edith and Agnes proves that even the most dastardly villain has a soft centre.

programme.title: Despicable Me 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy sequel featuring the voices of Steve Carell and Kristen Wiig. The Anti-Villain League recruits former supervillain Gru to lead an investigation and find the person responsible for stealing a secret Arctic laboratory.

programme.title: Despicable Me 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Steve Carell, Kristen Wiig and Trey Parker. Having already acquired a wife and three orphan daughters, reformed supervillain Gru now discovers that he has a long-lost twin, Dru. But Dru is hoping he can convince his brother to return to his wicked ways...

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure. SpongeBob the friendly sea sponge sets out from his home town of Bikini Bottom with his starfish friend, Patrick, to reclaim King Neptune's stolen crown.

programme.title: Mr Peabody and Sherman
programme.desc: Animated sci-fi adventure, featuring the voices of Ty Burrell and Max Charles. Super-intelligent dog Mr Peabody and his adopted boy Sherman use their time machine to experience great moments in history. However, when the boy takes fellow student Penny back in time and causes a rift, it's up to his canine mentor to rescue them both before her parents realise she's missing.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Hungry
programme.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holiday-makers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose. Horror thriller, starring Madison Davenport and Tracey Bonner

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: The Cinema List: Superheroes
programme.desc: Never fear, your heroes are here! Join us as we soar into the action-packed worlds of our favourite superheroes, from Superman and Wonder Woman to Hulk and Madame Web.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller, directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his assistant Dr John Watson think they have seen the back of serial killer Lord Blackwood. But when the evil occultist apparently comes back from the dead, they are once again drawn into a dangerous game.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
programme.desc: Period mystery thriller directed by Guy Ritchie, starring Robert Downey Jr and Jude Law. Sherlock Holmes and his trusty assistant Dr Watson are once again drawn into a battle of wits with arch nemesis Professor Moriarty. And this time the evil genius's plan could spell disaster for the whole of Europe.

programme.title: The Girl on the Train
programme.desc: Mystery thriller based on the bestselling novel, starring Emily Blunt and Rebecca Ferguson. Divorce is made all the more painful for Rachel Watson because her morning commute takes her past the home where her ex-husband lives with his new wife. Rachel becomes curious about an attractive couple living close by, and her interest develops into an obsession when the woman is declared missing. Although convinced she may know something about the disappearance, Rachel's strained emotional state and a history of alcohol abuse make her story hard to believe.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Dead Man's Wire
programme.desc: Tony Kiritsis is convinced mortgage broker ML Hall cheated him out of profits from a land development deal and he vows revenge. Tony walks into a branch of the Meridian Mortgage company for a meeting with ML, only to find his target is on holiday and the appointment will be with ML's son Richard instead. Regardless, Tony reveals a shotgun and holds Richard hostage for his father's supposed crimes. Director Gus Van Sant's thriller, starring Bill Skarsgård, Al Pacino and Dacre Montgomery

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Oscar-winning melodrama starring Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger and Jack Nicholson. Aurora Greenway is an attractive widow whose main problems in life are fending off an alarming number of suitors and keeping her headstrong daughter Emma in check. But as the years pass by, Aurora's attitude to life and love, and her relationship with her daughter, begin to change.

programme.title: Cat Ballou
programme.desc: Comedy western starring Jane Fonda and Lee Marvin. Schoolteacher Catherine Ballou returns home to find her father's life under threat from developers who want his ranch land. To protect him, Catherine assembles a motley bunch of outlaws including Kid Shelleen, an ageing gunfighter with a fondness for alcohol.

programme.title: Anatomy of a Murder
programme.desc: Classic courtroom drama, starring James Stewart, Lee Remick and Ben Gazzara. When an army lieutenant is held for the killing of a bartender, his defence is "justifiable homicide", on the grounds that the man had viciously assaulted and raped his wife. Paul Biegler is the lawyer hired to defend him.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Musical based on the hit stage show, starring John Travolta and Olivia Newton-John. Unexpectedly reunited with summer love Danny at her new high school, Sandy Olsson can't believe how different he is. Can the new Danny Zuko, the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-birds, really be the boy she met down at the beach? Perhaps Frenchy and Rizzo, both members of the super-cool Pink Ladies gang, can help her develop some street cred to win back his heart.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Musical starring Michelle Pfeiffer and Maxwell Caulfield. September 1961, and it's back to school for the students of Rydell High. As the T-Birds and Pink Ladies reassemble, Michael, a handsome young Englishman, joins the senior class. The status quo is soon under threat when he falls in love with Stephanie, the most beautiful of the Pink Ladies.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Romantic thriller starring Kevin Costner and Whitney Houston. Bodyguard and former secret serviceman Frank Farmer, still haunted by the assassination attempt on President Reagan, is asked to safeguard superstar singer and actress Rachel Marron who has been receiving death threats. But when Farmer visits Marron's luxurious home he is met with resentment from the singer and those around her.

programme.title: The Green Mile
programme.desc: Fantasy prison drama based on the novel by Stephen King, starring Tom Hanks and featuring Michael Clarke Duncan. Retired warder Paul Edgecomb remembers his time in charge of death-row inmates in a Louisiana penitentiary, and the strange powers of convicted child killer John Coffey.

programme.title: Roofman
programme.desc: Former US Army Reserve officer Jeffrey Manchester executes a plan to rob multiple branches of McDonald's. He is eventually captured by police and becomes the first person to escape from Brown Creek Correctional Institution in North Carolina. Jeffrey hides out at a toy shop for several months, and during forays outside the building, he sparks romance with store worker Leigh Wainscott. Comedy drama, starring Channing Tatum, Kirsten Dunst and Peter Dinklage

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two boys bonded by their lack of popularity. When the pair finally get invited to a party they embark on a quest to procure alcohol in the hope that it will not only lay to rest their geeky reputation but also improve their chances with the opposite sex.

programme.title: Zoolander
programme.desc: Satirical comedy starring Ben Stiller as Derek Zoolander, the vain, self-absorbed king of the male-modelling world. But Zoolander's fame and fortune are threatened when he's brainwashed into assassinating an eminent statesman whose proposed new child-labour laws would spell disaster for the fashion industry.

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Logan Lucky
programme.desc: Comedy caper directed by Steven Soderbergh, starring Channing Tatum, Adam Driver and Daniel Craig. Two down-on-their-luck brothers decide to rob the Charlotte Motor Speedway in North Carolina. In order to pull off the job, they need the help of explosives expert Joe Bang - but first they must break him out of prison.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
programme.desc: Romantic comedy sequel starring Renée Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Chiwetel Ejiofor. Still mourning the tragic death of her husband, Bridget Jones starts a fresh chapter as a single mum. With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: A retiree grows tired of the quiet life and becomes an intern at a start-up run by a beautiful entrepreneur, and teaches the young staff a few things about successful business. Comedy, starring Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway and Rene Russo

programme.title: Paul
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On their much anticipated road trip to America's notorious Area 51, two sci-fi geeks find themselves in the company of a real-life extraterrestrial who needs their help.

programme.title: Singin' in the Rain
programme.desc: Classic musical comedy starring Gene Kelly, Debbie Reynolds and Donald O'Connor. Silent film stars Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont are the golden couple of 1920s Hollywood. However, when "talkies" become all the rage, prima donna Lina is shown up by the new technology and aspiring actress Kathy Selden is called in to dub her voice.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

programme.title: Hummingbird
programme.desc: Thriller starring Jason Statham. A troubled former soldier on the run from a court martial assumes another man's identity and goes into hiding on the streets of London. But the desire to avenge injustice is something he can never leave behind.

programme.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Samuel L Jackson and Margot Robbie. Tarzan, now living in England as Lord Greystoke, returns to the Congo to investigate a slave trader.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Martin Lawrence and Will Smith as motormouth Miami cops Burnett and Lowrey, who are assigned to bring down a drugs lord and stop the flow of ecstasy into the city. But the operation and the officers' friendship are compromised by Lowrey's relationship with a female agent - who also happens to be Burnett's sister.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Gerard Butler, Morgan Freeman and Aaron Eckhart. A disgraced former bodyguard to the President of the United States gets the chance to redeem himself when he becomes trapped inside the White House following a terrorist attack.

programme.title: Snakes on a Plane
programme.desc: Action horror thriller starring Samuel L Jackson and Julianna Margulies. Grizzled FBI agent Neville Flynn is accompanying Mob murder witness Sean Jones on a flight from from Hawaii to Los Angeles, where Jones is due to testify against brutal crime boss Eddie Kim. But the aircraft holds a concealed cargo of lethal, aggressive reptiles.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg. Four years after the Battle of Chicago, the Autobots are now in hiding from the US government after being deemed a threat to humanity. So when struggling engineer Cade Yeager comes across an old semi truck while looking for parts, he soon finds himself on the radar of government forces and an alien bounty hunter.

programme.title: Bullet Train
programme.desc: Action comedy thriller starring Brad Pitt, Brian Tyree Henry and Aaron Taylor-Johnson. Mishap-prone assassin Ladybug's latest assignment takes him on a hair-raising journey aboard the titular Japanese high-speed train, where he must retrieve a briefcase from a pair of British hitmen. But this oddball trio are not the only hired killers on board...

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Action fantasy starring Tom Hardy, Michelle Williams and Riz Ahmed. While continuing an investigation into the Life Foundation, the mysterious organisation that ruined both his career and his relationship months earlier, struggling reporter Eddie Brock unwittingly becomes the host of a ferociously unpredictable alien parasite. But is the shape-shifting organism a force for good or evil?

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Jet Li. A highly skilled group of mercenaries are commissioned by a shady operative to assassinate the murderous dictator of a South American island. But they should know that an operation like this is never straightforward.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Will Smith and featuring Jaden Smith. After his wife walks out, downtrodden medical salesman Chris Gardner is left to bring up his five-year-old son alone. The situation worsens when the pair are made homeless, but Gardner refuses to be beaten. Gaining a prestigious though unpaid stockbroker internship, he doggedly chases his dream of a better life.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: Drama starring Eddie Peng. After spending time in prison for manslaughter, taciturn former stunt rider and musician Lang returns to his home town in remote north west China. He joins a local team rounding up stray dogs in preparation for the 2008 Olympics. One mutt proves particularly problematic, but Lang slowly begins to strike up a bond with the animal.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pyjamas
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Asa Butterfield, Jack Scanlon and David Thewlis. After his Nazi officer father is given a promotion, young Bruno and his family are moved from Berlin to a remote house in the countryside. With nothing to do and no friends of his own age, Bruno becomes curious about a nearby building known as "the farm" and its oddly clothed inhabitants.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Hamlet
programme.desc: A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Will Smith and featuring Jaden Smith. After his wife walks out, downtrodden medical salesman Chris Gardner is left to bring up his five-year-old son alone. The situation worsens when the pair are made homeless, but Gardner refuses to be beaten. Gaining a prestigious though unpaid stockbroker internship, he doggedly chases his dream of a better life.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Sasquatch Sunset
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Riley Keough and Jesse Eisenberg. A year in the life of a family of Sasquatches living in a North American forest as they try to survive a gradually infringing modern world.

programme.title: Constantine
programme.desc: Supernatural action fantasy based on the Hellblazer comic book, starring Keanu Reeves as troubled Los Angeles exorcist John Constantine. After a young Catholic girl takes her own life, Constantine is approached by her grieving twin sister. As they begin to investigate, they enter a world of the supernatural that sees the pair come face to face with the hidden evil that inhabits the Earth.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Radha Mitchell and Vin Diesel. When a transport ship crashes on a seemingly deserted planet, things seem bad enough for the few survivors. But with this desolate world about to be plunged into darkness by an eclipse, their nightmare is only just beginning.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller, the sequel to Pitch Black, starring Vin Diesel. Antihero convict Riddick finds himself on the run from intergalactic bounty hunters, but when he seeks refuge on a strange planet he discovers that the place has been overrun by the all-powerful Necromongers, storm-troopers bent on universal annihilation.

programme.title: Riddick
programme.desc: Sci-fi thriller starring Vin Diesel. Abandoned on a derelict planet, outlaw warrior Riddick must fight for survival against vicious alien predators. His only way of escape is to activate a distress beacon left behind by mercenaries.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The first sci-fi adventure movie based on the cult TV series, starring William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy. An unknown and awesome force is heading towards Federation space, on a direct course for Earth. The USS Enterprise is ordered back into immediate service and, with Captain James T Kirk once again in command, sets out to confront the mysterious alien menace.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and featuring Sharon Stone. After suffering a series of nightmares about Mars, construction worker Douglas Quaid discovers that the planet may in fact hold the key to his true identity.

programme.title: Acceleration
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, a crime lord whose tentacles permeate the underbelly of a seedy Los Angeles as he deals in guns, gambling, drugs and skin trafficking, finds himself double-crossed by his most trusted operative Rhona Zyocki. Vladik's propensity for power, control, and violence drives him to kidnap Rhona's young son. However, Vladik underestimates the power of a mother's love as she seeks revenge.

programme.title: The Sorcerers
programme.desc: Science-fiction horror starring Boris Karloff. A well-meaning professor discovers a way of controlling another person's mind through hypnotism. But his evil wife uses his research to corrupt a young man.

programme.title: Crash Dive

Despite their mutual antipathy, the former spouses unite and head to Bali, intent on sabotaging their only child's wedding plans and saving her from the same mistakes they made.

programme.title: Lisa Frankenstein
programme.desc: Romantic comedy horror starring Kathryn Newton and Cole Sprouse. As a child, Lisa Swallows was traumatised when she witnessed the murder of her mother. When a lightning strike reanimates his corpse, she helps him to heal by gathering together the body parts he is missing - which she chooses to "acquire" from her mortal enemies.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc:
The Numberblobs are gathered for a star-studded evening with the Family of Five's All-star Line-up. In the first half of the show, the Numberblobs watched performances from Numberblocks Five, Ten, Fifteen, Twenty and Twenty-five. But where are the rest of the Five Times Table friends? In the interval, word reaches the theatre that the remaining performers are stranded on their tour bus with a flat tyre. What will Five, Ten, Fifteen, Twenty and Twenty-five do now?
The show must go on as the crowd is eagerly awaiting the second half! Twenty-five realises that everyone in the Family of Fives is made of... you guessed it - fives. The friends get to work and discover that the next act is made of 6 Fives, it's Thirty. Twenty-five is already made of 5 Fives, and adding Five makes Thirty. It's showtime! Thirty heads up on stage and performs a fabulous juggling act. Her 3 juggling balls show that Thirty is made up of 3 Tens, but also 6 Fives. The Numberblobs love it.
Twenty realises that if Thirty is 6 lots of Five, the next act must be 7 lots of Five. Fifteen is 3 lots of Five, and Twenty is 4 lots of Five. 3 plus 4 is 7, which means Fifteen and Twenty put together make 7 lots of Five, which is Thirty-five. He is ready to perform with his Rainbow Flower Sunshine band, the 7 Fives. The crowd goes wild! Thirty and Ten jump together to make the Numberblock that comes after Thirty-five. It's Forty! He is made up of 4 Tens and 8 Fives. His performance is showing the Numberblobs his 40 favourite rectangles.
Suddenly 5 Tens zoom in. Fifty decided to race ahead of the tour bus to see if the friends needed some help, which is just as well as Thirty-five is trying to work out how to make Forty-five, which is 9 lots of Five. As Fifty is 10 lots of Five, you can remove one Five to get Forty-five. It's chime time! Forty-five performs a little jingle on her xylophone.
Finally, it's time for the superstar with the gold guitar - 10 Fives are Fifty! The rest of the Family of Five's All-star Line-up arrive just in the nick of time to take part in Fifty's super performance. Thanks to Five to Twenty-five putting their blocks together, the show was able to go on!

Toodloo makes it over with ease, while Great BigHoo struggles, and Chickedy and Chick are just too small. Great BigHoo decides to help them by picking them up and throwing them. Unfortunately Great BigHoo throws them too hard and they go flying up in the air - and land behind the rider on the back of the horse's saddle! As Great BigHoo and Toodloo look on, Chickedy and Chick ride around the course and go over the jumps, until the Hooter calls the Twirlywoos home.
While the Twirlywoos are away, unusually, there is a knock at the door! Peekaboo goes to investigate. It's the Stop-Go Car, who is playing a jumping game. Peekaboo joins in and jumps over the car, and the two jump over each other all around the boat, until they get back to the doors and the car drives away. The Twirlywoos return, and Peekaboo is on the wrong side of the boat, but jumps over their heads to avoid being seen and get safely back to the hole in the wall.

Chantelle and Rory's fact files explain about how many legs millipedes have, why they curl up and how they see. programme.desc: Tinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa Apso with lots of big dog energy. Charli and Tinks are at WUFS - the Woofton Upcycled Fashion Show - where Charli is going to be modelling some upcycled outfits. Tinks is confused, first by upcycling; is this bicycling uphill? And then by the catwalk at the fashion show; are there going to be cats? But Charli explains that upcycling is when you turn unwanted clothes into something new. Making new outfits from old ones gives them new life and stops them going to waste. And no, there won't be any cats on the catwalk. Tinks watches as Charli's old T-shirt is transformed into a new bag. But she has to find Joe the designer in a hurry when Charli misses her mark on stage during rehearsals and track down a missing fringe after it gets accidentally swept away. And then it's showtime - and time for Charli to shine. But, disaster! Charli's new bag is dropped on the catwalk, right in front of Charli's wheelchair. programme.desc:
Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some pygmy marmosets. These tiny monkeys are the smallest in the world - they are about the size of a tennis ball. These treetop athletes can turn their heads nearly halfway around and look backwards. Aneeshwar and Lizzie give it a go.
Next, they meet a giant spider with a giant web - the orb weaver spider. When her keeper throws some food onto her web, she immediately feels the vibrations and races to catch it. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection between these two incredible animals is.

programme.desc: The documentary looks at how Britain identified Mikhail Gorbachev as a possible new contender for Soviet leader, believing he could be the ticket to better relations between East and West. programme.title: John Simpson - Sixty Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson takes a look back at his 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global news stories of the era. John also reminisces on memorable encounters with inspiring leaders and cruel dictators

programme.title: Finding Britain's Slave Traders with David Olusoga
programme.desc: Part one of two. David meets the historians who have built the Register of British Slave Traders, piecing together a comprehensive picture of more than 13,000 individuals who were investors in the slave trade, showing the links between modern British institutions and the trade in human beings. programme.title: Clo Beag Chirsty Bella
programme.desc:
Tha Chirsty Bella ag iarraidh Clò Hearach a dhèanamh...tha e gu math nas fhasa smaoineachadh air sin na tha e ga chuir an gnìomh. Tha ì a' fuireach ann an Scalpaigh, Na Hearadh. Tha gaol aice air a h-eilean agus tha ì ga cumail fhèin trang le bhith a reic uighean agus a dèanamh dannsa Gàidheallach. 'S toigh leatha cuideachd an clò ainmeil clùiteach: Clò Hearach. Tha an t-seann bheairt mar time machine, ga toirt air ais gu lìnn an fhearsaid, nan càrd, 's a spàl. An teid orra à clò a dhèanamh ann an àm?
Chirsty Bella wants to produce her own Harris tweed but that is easier said than done. She lives in Scalpay, a little village in the Isle of Harris, loves her island and keeps herself going through little jobs like selling eggs and traditional Scottish Highland dancing. She also loves the famous and traditional fabric: Harris Tweed. The original Harris Tweed loom is like a time machine that takes her back over a hundred years to the age of spindles, combs and shuttles. Will she manage to weave her cloth in time?

programme.title: Belle agus Sebastian
programme.desc: When Belle is injured and lost, Sebastian goes searching for her. Even Anton the poacher doesn’t know anything. However, Sebastian then hears about the Happy Shelter

programme.title: Seonaidh (Shaun the Sheep)
programme.desc: When the Farmer tasks Bitzer with ridding the farm of a pesky crow, Shaun comes up with an ingenious disguise to fool the intruder. However, the plan backfires when he's suspected of being the crazed chicken thief of Mossybottom Farm

programme.title: Mod 2026
programme.desc: Cathy Macdonald presents live coverage of the Gold Medal final for solo singing from the Royal National Mòd in Glasgow. The leading men and women from the qualifying competitions earlier in the day perform in front of the adjudicators in the Main Auditorium in the Glasgow Royal Concert Hall as they compete for the An Comunn Gàidhealach Gold Medal. This year’s hopefuls will be hoping to emulate the success of Caitlyn Yule and Finlay John Morse in last year’s competition in Lochaber. Cathy is joined in the studio by two guests with a keen interest in, and knowledge of, Gaelic music and song, to offer assessments of the competitors’ performances. The show also features successful competitors vying for the prestigious Silver Pendant for solo singing for adult learners

programme.title: Dàna: Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Coinneach MacFhraing seeks out unclimbed lines and challenging new routes on the remote and beautiful island of Rona

programme.title: Eòin Dino (Dino Birds)
programme.desc: Part two of two. An insight into the evolution of birds - how they have conquered multiple territories and adapted to every environment on Earth. The history of birds can be traced back 220 million years. A recent discovery of the oldest fossil of a modern bird offers new clues about how and why they were the only ones to survive the deadly asteroid impact that wiped out most of Earth's creatures - and reveals the secret of their evolutionary success

programme.title: Skipinnish aig a' Chaisteal (Shorts)

programme.title: Ruairidh Gray aig Barrowland
programme.desc: Megan MacLellan presents a concert from Gaelic singer Ruairidh Gray at the Barrowland Ballroom. From performing in small village halls in South Uist, The Mòd double gold medalist is joined onstage in Scotland's most iconic music venue by a stellar cast of dance band musicians as 'the home of rock and roll' is transformed into a gathering place for Gaels

programme.title: Damilola: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Twenty-six years after the murder of 10-year-old Damilola Taylor shocked Britain, this documentary examines his story with new testimony that sheds fresh light on what happened. Actor John Boyega, who was eight when Damilola died and was one of the last people to see him alive, joins Damilola's childhood friends to return to his final months and the years of youth violence that followed his death

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors
programme.desc: As the players go deeper into the game, a new day brings new suspicions amongst the faithful. The mission forces the celebrities to work in teams under terrifying conditions, and with the murdering hour approaching, the players take their seats at the round table

programme.title: The Celebrity Traitors: Uncloaked
programme.desc: Ed Gamble will be joined by celebrities and players to analyse and react to developments in the castle

programme.desc: Val has to come up with a plan to pass the vampire initiation ceremony despite his huge secret. However, his curiosity about human life gets the better of him, and he sneaks to the village, where he bumps into Gertie and is thrust straight into human family life. His two worlds collide when he's invited to a party

programme.title: The Best of Weatherman Walking
