programme.title: The Devil's Confession - The Lost Eichmann Tapes
programme.desc: Part one of two. Escaping from postwar Europe, Nazi war criminal Adolf Eichmann established a new life in Argentina, where he met Dutch journalist and fellow Nazi Willem Sassen. In Buenos Aires in 1957, they recorded a comprehensive account of his career, but the tapes disappeared when Eichmann was captured and taken to stand trial in Jerusalem. Excerpts of his interview surfaced in Life magazine, and Israeli prosecutor Gideon Hausner was determined to use Eichmann's recorded confession as evidence during the trial

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Florence Headlam and Sue Kent are in Stevenage to help mother and daughter Margaret and Elizabeth transform their south-facing garden into a serene, shaded relaxation space

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Friends Louise, Mark, Suzy and Rich compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Game show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon journeys deep into Canada's vast and empty Yukon Territory, one of North America's most remote landscapes. Covering an area almost the size of Spain but home to fewer than 50,000 people, the Yukon is a land of immense forests, glaciers, rivers and wildlife. Simon wants to find out how the people and the wildlife of this immense wilderness are faring, all while searching for grizzly bears

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson
programme.desc: The journalist in conversation with people who influence our political thinking about what has shaped theirs

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: It's the last chance for the remaining 17 contestants to compete for a possible £10,000 jackpot. Right answers take them closer to the big money, but if at any stage they give an Impossible answer, they will immediately be knocked out. Quiz, hosted by Rick Edwards

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face the Final Run and earn the opportunity to take home their cash prize

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Quiz hosted by Susan Calman in which one contestant becomes the Boss and has to use judgement and tactics to decide which player is best suited to answer questions

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael concludes his journey from Cumbria to Dumfries and Galloway by crossing the Solway Firth, where he visits the last home of Scotland's Bard Robert Burns. Further north into the Lowther Hills, Michael strikes gold in the rich geological landscape around Wanlockhead, Scotland's highest village, and rides a charming heritage industrial railway across the stunning terrain. His journey ends at the spectacular Palladian mansion of Dumfries House, home to a world-class Chippendale furniture collection and the headquarters of the King's Foundation

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Dublin-based architects Fiona Brugha and Paddy Dunne convert a derelict cowshed belonging to the vast Rockingham Estate in the dense forest of Lough Key. The pair plan to turn the thick stone walled ruin into a contemporary family home for themselves and their two small children. Their budget is €350,000, but a restoration project among the trees doesn't come without challenges

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team visit Hampton Court to value more of the public's antiques, and cast their eyes over a rare long-case clock, an early sketch by the abstract artist Mondrian and a bronze produced by Rodin. First shown in 2004

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Charlie Ross and Will Axon assess items at Ragley Hall in Warwickshire, including a Busby hat and a Worcester coffee set. Presenter Paul Martin explores the Battle of Edgehill

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Chizzy Akudolu, Stephen Bailey, Banjo Beale, and Philippa Dunne test their general knowledge skills in a series of quiz rounds selected by host Michael Sheen

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor is on hand with more behind-the-scenes action and is joined by a trio of Strictly all-stars to discuss all things ballroom. Plus, more exclusive interviews with some of the remaining celebrities

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Matt Chorley

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond visits the Sheep Dog World Trial at Lauder in the Scottish Borders, finding out how the family hosting the event turned their working farm into a championship venue and meeting some of the international competitors and their dogs taking part. Rosie Morton is on Bute for a trialling masterclass from one of the sport's best handlers, while Cammy Wilson is at the Kelso Ram Sales investigating the continuing decline in sheep numbers in Scotland. Anne Lundon visits a craftswoman keeping the tradition of crook-making alive

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is tackling jobs in the autumn garden and introduces plants that keep colour and interest going for as long as possible. Jamie Butterworth delves into the fascinating world of shade-loving plants, and Ashley Edwards joins sound artist Jason Singh for an unusual journey through the garden, Plus, A couple have designed a garden around an elaborate miniature railway

programme.title: Six Wives with Lucy Worsley
programme.desc: Lucy talks about the impact of Anne Boleyn on Henry VIII's affections, uncovering private moments that were reported by eyewitnesses or recorded in historical documents. The key moments during their marriage are recreated, as Anne falls from favour in court and is eventually executed, despite protestations of innocence regarding the rumours of her infidelity. As soon as Anne is dead, Henry marries Jane Seymour, who fulfils her most important role as Queen - giving birth to the healthy son that Henry has craved for so long

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: Classic psychological thriller starring Jodie Foster and Anthony Hopkins. Promising FBI student Clarice Starling is assigned to help in the search for the serial killer known as "Buffalo Bill", a brutal murderer who skins the bodies of his female victims. Starling seeks the assistance of Dr Hannibal "the Cannibal" Lecter, a sociopathic former psychiatrist held in a maximum security hospital for the criminally insane.

programme.title: In Fabric
programme.desc: Supernatural horror comedy starring Marianne Jean-Baptiste and Hayley Squires. Recently divorced Sheila is looking for a dress to impress, and happens upon a striking red gown that she quickly snaps up. When Sheila finds herself caught up in strange and increasingly dangerous events, though, the culprit may well be the mysterious, malevolent garment.

programme.title: Pierre
programme.desc: The solicitor is still in shock after Michael's body was discovered. And when his colleague Alecia finds out something unsettling from Michael's past, Pierre begins to question his own judgement. Meanwhile, Pierre is pulled into another duty case involving a family business in trouble

programme.title: Fellow Travelers
programme.desc: Tim is excited to go on a road trip with Hawk, but their jaunt turns sour when he realises his friend is using the journey to dig up dirt on Senator Smith's enemies. Marcus and Frankie's encounter with a racist bouncer nearly tears them apart, while Roy tries desperately to prevent David from being drafted for the Vietnam War effort. In the 1980s, Tim is reticent to forgive Hawk - until a medical emergency strikes

programme.title: Fellow Travelers
programme.desc: The government's purge of homosexuals continues apace, and Hawk is thrust under suspicion when he must face a polygraph test. His solution is to very publicly court Lucy, but where does that leave Tim? Hawk involves him in a desperate scheme to destroy McCarthy and Cohn. Cohn has his own desperation to contend with, threatening to sabotage the Army now that David has been drafted. And in 1986, Tim recruits Hawk to help his AIDS activist group

programme.title: Becca's Story: Stand Up to Cancer
programme.desc: Becca had a zest for life and dreamed of becoming a doctor. Shortly after qualifying, she was diagnosed with an aggressive form of ovarian cancer. Her family share the story of her rapidly progressing illness

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
programme.desc: Jon Richardson and Judi Love host the companion programme, in which they are joined by Bake Off judges Paul Hollywood and Nigella Lawson to look back at the highlights of bread week. They celebrate the standout moments and serve up their take on the episode's biggest talking points and best bakes

programme.title: Grand Designs
programme.desc: Kevin meets south London chef Corinne, who loves to entertain and is rustling up plans for a beautifully crafted, double-kitchen home designed around her love of cooking. The end-of-terrace plot is on a hill and surrounded by woodland within a strict conservation area, so it won't be an easy build. But having come through a divorce and cancer treatment, Corinne sees the house as vital on so many levels, not least as an opportunity to create a space that represents her new lease of life

programme.title: Sunday Brunch
programme.desc: Conversation, cooking and celebrity guests, presented by Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer

programme.title: The Dog House
programme.desc: Olympic cyclist Victoria Pendleton visits Woodgreen animal charity, keen to find a dog she can co-parent with her mother. She meets Leilo, but the Rhodesian ridgeback's long-term medical needs require serious consideration. Lovebirds Shai and Orin's try to hit it off with Polo the lurcher, while Zoe the beagle meets the Forristal family

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Carrie finds out that while they were dating, Doug lied to her about getting a job in the hope she would be more inclined to sleep with him. Starring Kevin James and Leah Remini

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug and Carrie feel unpopular at their workplaces, and both overcompensate in an effort to rectify the situation. American comedy, starring Kevin James and Leah Remini

programme.title: The King of Queens
programme.desc: Doug is peeved to learn Deacon has had a sandwich named after him at Coopers. Meanwhile, Carrie plots to prevent Holly moving to Manhattan. American comedy, starring Kevin James and Leah Remini

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Debra helps to plan a recruitment party at Frank's lodge, leading Ray to grumble about how much time she is spending away from home. Comedy, starring Patricia Hearten and Ray Romano

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ally babysits the twins, and does such a good job that Debra gives her even more responsibility around the house. However, Marie fears her granddaughter is being treated like a slave

programme.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
programme.desc: Ray worries Debra's criticism will make the children think he is a fool, and hatches a plan to win back their respect

programme.title: Frasier
programme.desc: Frasier sets his sights on a policewoman - but little does he know she has a crush on his father

programme.title: Frasier

programme.desc: A grieving son returns to England to mourn his father, the CEO of Elsinore Property. The shell-shocked Hamlet learns plans are already afoot for his uncle Claudius to marry his mother Gertrude just days after losing her husband. Contemporary drama based on the Shakespeare classic, starring Riz Ahmed, Morfydd Clark, Joe Alwyn, Timothy Spall and Art Malik

programme.title: Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie
programme.desc: When a scheme to book a show at a local nightspot goes disastrously wrong, Toronto musicians Matt and Jay are unexpectedly transported back to 2008. Fantasy comedy, starring Matt Johnson and Jay McCarrol

programme.title: The Deb
programme.desc: A young farmer hopes a debutante ball will transform her life. Her city cousin arrives after being expelled from school and scoffs at the traditions. As they search for dates, the teenagers challenge each other's assumptions. Comedy musical, starring Natalie Abbott, Charlotte MacInnes, and Rebel Wilson, who also directed

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A pig who works as a bounty hunter finds himself trekking the globe with a free-spirited elephant he intended to capture. Animated comedy, with the voices of Jason Sudeikis, Lilly Singh and Rainn Wilson

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Biographical drama charting the meteoric rise, dramatic fall and remarkable resurgence of British pop icon, Robbie Williams

programme.title: One Last Shot
programme.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network. Director James Nunn's thriller, starring Scott Adkins, Steven Cree and Hannah Ware

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Mexicali
programme.desc: Former fighter Joe helps run a Mexican farm with his partner, Estrella. After entering underground bouts to support the workers, he is ambushed by a gang and forced to fight for his life. Action thriller, starring Bren Foster and Tania Raymonde

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Halloween Ends
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene

programme.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
programme.desc: Sequel to 1997's Anaconda, starring Johnny Messner and KaDee Strickland. In the heart of the Borneo jungle, giant anacondas prey on a group of foolhardy scientists who are hunting for a rare orchid with youth-preserving qualities.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger

programme.title: The Woman in the Yard
programme.desc: Inside a rural farmhouse, painter Ramona Harris recuperates with a leg brace following a head-on car collision that claimed the life of her husband. Out of the blue, a woman in funereal garb materialises in a chair on the front lawn of the fixer-upper, and she has no intention of leaving. Psychological horror, starring Danielle Deadwyler, Peyton Jackson and Estella Kahiha

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Supernatural horror starring Lin Shaye. Psychic Elise Rainier returns to her childhood home, where she must confront her own past traumas in order to exorcise the property.

programme.title: Brightburn
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Elizabeth Banks, David Denman and Jackson A Dunn. A Kansas couple discovers a humanoid alien child inside a crashed spaceship and adopt him. Years later, the boy reaches adolescence - and starts to develop powers that pose a major threat to his community.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Period horror thriller starring Michael B Jordan. In 1932 Mississippi, enterprising twin brothers Elijah and Elias, aka "Smoke" and "Stack", prepare to set up a juke joint to serve their town's black community. But there's a nasty presence hanging around town on opening night, just waiting for the sun to go down.

programme.title: Halloween Ends
programme.desc: Horror sequel starring Jamie Lee Curtis, James Jude Courtney and Nick Castle. Psychopath Michael Myers has been incarcerated for 40 years, following his killing spree in small-town Haddonfield. Living in fear of Myers's possible return, survivor Laurie Strode has turned her home into a fortress and prepared her sceptical family for the worst. When Myers escapes, the stage is set for a showdown.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Western directed by Quentin Tarantino, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Jamie Foxx, Samuel L Jackson and Christoph Waltz. After being freed from slavery and trained in the ways of a bounty hunter by Dr King Schultz, Django sets out to free his wife from a vicious plantation owner.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Heroes
programme.desc: From Wonder Woman and Indiana Jones to Trolls, expect daring adventures, epic battles and heroes and heroines saving the day

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: The Legend of Tarzan
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Alexander Skarsgård, Samuel L Jackson and Margot Robbie. Tarzan, now living in England as Lord Greystoke, returns to the Congo to investigate a slave trader.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: xXx
programme.desc: Spy action thriller starring Vin Diesel as extreme-sports fanatic Xander Cage, who is coerced by the US government into infiltrating a Prague-based terrorist organisation when he falls foul of the law.

programme.title: xXx: The Next Level
programme.desc: Spy thriller sequel starring Ice Cube, Willem Dafoe and Samuel L Jackson. When a devious general threatens to overthrow the government, US Intelligence chief Augustus Gibbons concocts the perfect solution - recruit dangerous renegade Darius Stone as the new secret agent XXX.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Kal-El, one of the last survivors of the planet Krypton, attempts to protect the people of Earth from evil genius Lex Luthor. Superman is assisted by the Justice Gang, comprising Guy Gardner, aka Green Lantern, Kendra Saunders, aka Hawkgirl, Michael Holt, aka Mister Terrific and Rex Mason, aka Metamorpho. Writer/director James Gunn's fantasy adventure, starring David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan and Nicholas Hoult

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Years after the disaster at Jurassic Park, a new attraction is opened on the same site. But over time, the novelty has started to wear off so the park's scientists go back to the lab in the hope of creating an exciting new dinosaur: an apex predator, no less, called the "indoraptor". What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Superhero action adventure starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr. Peter Parker, aka Spider-Man, yearns to become a member of super-team the Avengers, and is frustrated when Tony Stark urges him to first finish high school. However, when Parker discovers a local man is illegally selling alien technology, the nascent hero spies an opportunity to prove his world-saving worth.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as drifter and ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who falls foul of the redneck sheriff of Hope, Oregon. Arrested and beaten, Rambo escapes and takes refuge in the local woods, ready to defend himself with deadly skills learnt during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dustin Hoffman, Robin Williams, Julia Roberts and Bob Hoskins. Workaholic lawyer Peter Banning and his family spend Christmas in London with an old relative, Granny Wendy. The adults arrive home one evening to find that the children have vanished and a note has been left by Captain James Hook. With the help of a fairy named Tinkerbell, Peter sets off for Neverland to reclaim his offspring.

programme.title: The Witches
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Anjelica Huston and Mai Zetterling. After the death of his parents, young Luke visits England. His grandmother, Helga, has warned Luke about witches so he's not surprised when he discovers that their seaside hotel is hosting an English witch convention. However, the star guest at the convention is the Grand High Witch, who reveals her dastardly plan to turn the nation's children into rodents.

programme.title: The Wiz
programme.desc: Musical based on The Wizard of Oz, featuring an all-black cast. Dorothy is suddenly whisked off to a magical land and makes some unusual friends as she tries to get back home, while avoiding the malevolent attentions of a wicked witch. Directed by Sidney Lumet, starring Diana Ross, Michael Jackson and Richard Pryor

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Ralph Macchio. When Daniel LaRusso moves from New Jersey to California, he becomes a target for a bullying gang of teenagers. Knowing he must learn how to defend himself, he strikes up a friendship with a wise old Japanese man, who teaches him the secrets of karate. However, his bitterest enemy is also taking martial arts lessons and the scene is set for an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure, a remake of the popular 1984 film, starring Jackie Chan and Jaden Smith. Moving from his home town of Detroit to China is quite a culture shock for young Dre Parker, a situation made worse when he falls foul of the class bully. But under the guidance of maintenance man Mr Han, Dre learns to defend himself.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: On the isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been enemies for generations, young warrior Hiccup breaks tradition by forming an unlikely bond with Toothless, a feared Night Fury. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Mason Thames, Nico Parker and Gerard Butler

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: When Papa Smurf is taken by evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel, Smurfette leads her fellow blue creatures on a mission to the real world to save him. Live-action animated musical fantasy comedy, featuring the voices of Rihanna, James Corden and Nick Offerman

programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy adventure based on the first three titles in the bestselling children's book series, starring Jim Carrey and Meryl Streep. After their parents die in a mysterious fire, three young siblings are entrusted to the care of their distant relative, the evil Count Olaf. An actor and master of disguise, he's prepared to go to any length to swindle them out of their family fortune.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Robin Williams. In 1969, a young boy called Alan gets trapped in the strange jungle world of a magical board game he has unearthed on a building site. Twenty-six years later, two children discover the game and unwittingly unleash its dangerous magic. They also release Alan, now an adult, who realises that to escape the game they must play it to the end.

programme.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan, Kevin Hart and Jack Black. Four high-school students discover a dusty 1990s video game and are sucked into its world as the characters they chose. They soon discover that if they lose their three "lives" in the game, they will be killed in real life. In order to survive, they must complete the game and break its curse.

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure sequel starring Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart and Karen Gillan. Two years after the events of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle, the teenagers must return to the magical video game to rescue one of their own. But when they get there, the players are baffled to find that everything about the game - and themselves - has changed.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone as ex-Green Beret John Rambo, who embarks on a covert mission to find proof that US soldiers are being held in Vietnamese prison camps. When he finds the PoWs, Rambo decides to try to rescue them single-handedly.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Action drama starring Sylvester Stallone. Vietnam veteran John Rambo is tracked down to a Buddhist monastery by his friend Colonel Trautman, who wants help fighting Soviet forces in Afghanistan. Rambo declines, but when Trautman is captured by the Soviets, the one-man army goes into action.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Trapped
programme.desc: This edition of The Cinema List is about being trapped. From the depths of the ocean in 47 Meters Down to the vastness of space in Gravity, getting out is easier said than done

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: War drama starring Matthew Modine and Adam Baldwin. After a gruelling eight weeks of extensive training and military induction under the sadistic rule of Gunnery Sergeant Hartman, a disparate group of US Marines faces real combat in Vietnam.

programme.title: The African Queen
programme.desc: Classic First World War romantic adventure starring Humphrey Bogart and Katharine Hepburn. East Africa, 1914: when her home is destroyed by invading Germans, a prim missionary finds an unlikely saviour in the scruffy, gin-drinking captain of a small steam-driven riverboat, The African Queen. Together, the indomitable pair begin a treacherous journey downriver to conduct their own private battle against the enemy.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: Cool Hand Luke
programme.desc: Prison drama starring Paul Newman and George Kennedy. After being sentenced to two years on a chain gang, Luke Jackson is faced with the unrelenting demands of the camp's daily routine. However, his resilience quickly antagonises the gang boss.

programme.title: The Shawshank Redemption
programme.desc: Prison drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman. Maine 1946: sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder of his wife and her lover, mild-mannered banker Andy Dufresne tries to adapt to the brutalities of prison life. Over the years, Dufresne's friendship with long-term inmate Red and the discovery that his financial expertise is suddenly in big demand make his ordeal easier to bear.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: Second World War drama based on the novel by JG Ballard, starring Christian Bale and John Malkovich. When the Imperial Japanese army marches into Shanghai in December 1941, the privileged life 11-year-old Jim Graham enjoys with his family in the city's International Settlement comes to an end. In the ensuing turmoil, Jim is separated from his parents.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Erotic thriller starring Michael Douglas and Sharon Stone. After a former rock star is brutally murdered with an ice pick, San Francisco detective Nick Curran interviews Catherine Tramell, the star's novelist girlfriend, whose last book contained an identical killing. Curran, who is trying to reform his excessive lifestyle with the help of a police psychologist, soon becomes dangerously involved with his key suspect.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: When a spy is suspected of treason, her husband faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country. Director Steven Soderbergh's thriller, starring Michael Fassbender, Cate Blanchett and Rege-Jean Page

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: The Thicket
programme.desc: When a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer in a snowbound wilderness, they follow him into a deadly land known as the Thicket. Director Elliott Lester's drama, starring Peter Dinklage, Juliette Lewis, Gbenga Akinnagbe and Levon Hawke

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: Two rivals fight for control of a major crime family. Director Barry Levinson's drama based on true events, starring Robert De Niro, Cosmo Jarvis and Debra Messing

programme.title: The Perfect Storm
programme.desc: Action drama based on real-life events, starring George Clooney and Mark Wahlberg. When down-on-his-luck skipper Billy Tyne sets out in the Andrea Gail to fish the Grand Banks of the North Atlantic, he has little idea that he and his crew will soon encounter a storm of unprecedented ferocity.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
programme.desc: Romantic action comedy starring Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie. Dissatisfied married couple John and Jane Smith live an outwardly respectable existence in suburbia, but they are soon shocked to discover their similar secret - they are both sophisticated professional assassins and their next lethal assignment is to kill one another.

programme.title: Hotel Mumbai
programme.desc: Thriller based on a true story starring Dev Patel. In 2008, ten Pakistani terrorists arrive in Mumbai and embark on a series of attacks throughout the city. After four of the gunmen enter the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel and start shooting, a waiter and the hotel's head chef are among those attempting to save guests' lives as they wait for help to come.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: The Alto Knights
programme.desc: Two rivals fight for control of a major crime family. Director Barry Levinson's drama based on true events, starring Robert De Niro, Cosmo Jarvis and Debra Messing

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Period comedy starring Will Ferrell. Ron Burgundy is the top newsreader at a San Diego TV station in the 1970s. But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: A retiree grows tired of the quiet life and becomes an intern at a start-up run by a beautiful entrepreneur, and teaches the young staff a few things about successful business. Comedy, starring Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway and Rene Russo

programme.title: Grimsby
programme.desc: Spy spoof starring Sacha Baron Cohen and Mark Strong. Nearly 30 years after they were adopted by different families, brothers Norman "Nobby" Butcher and Sebastian meet again. But the reunion proves to be fraught with problems now that one is an international spy and the other has stayed true to his hard-drinking, working-class, football-hooligan roots.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Jason Biggs. The randy students return for another summer of sexual misadventures following their first year at college.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: Mother's Pride
programme.desc: A grieving family who own a failing pub have their lives changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards. Comedy, starring Martin Clunes, James Buckley and Miles Jupp

programme.title: Pitch Perfect 2
programme.desc: Musical comedy starring Anna Kendrick and Rebel Wilson. Having been forcibly disbanded for disgracing themselves, a cappella group the Barden Bellas discover a get-out clause - all they have to do is win an international singing competition in Copenhagen.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Zoolander 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Ben Stiller, Owen Wilson and Penélope Cruz. Once-legendary catwalk icon Derek Zoolander is lured back into the fashion business by a beautiful agent investigating a spate of celebrity deaths.

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson as the accident-prone Mr Bean. In an attempt to get rid of him from his job as one of their attendants, the governors of the National Gallery send Mr Bean to America to represent them at the unveiling of the Grierson Gallery's new purchase. Needless to say disaster is never far away.

programme.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
programme.desc: Comedy starring Rowan Atkinson. Mr Bean puts the entente cordiale under considerable strain when he wins a camcorder and a trip to France in a raffle. After a typically accident-prone encounter with a Russian film director, the hapless hero ends up at the Cannes film festival.

programme.title: The Repair Shop: Beyond the Barn
programme.desc: Mark Stuckey restores a family's portable record player, radio and tape deck purchased in Uganda in 1972. Richard Talman rebuilds a delicate signet ring that once belonged to the owner's grandfather and Pete Woods repairs the giant crack in a Ghanaian djembe drum. Finally, camera expert Pierro Pozella investigates a 1950s Rolleiflex camera once owned by royal photographer Jack Barker, the man responsible for a famous image of the royal family at Balmoral

programme.title: Weather for the Week Ahead
programme.desc: A look ahead to the latest forecast

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: A round-up of national and international news, plus current affairs, arts and entertainment, and weather

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Gethin Jones and Gaby Roslin present the weekday magazine show featuring a mixture of topical discussion and expert advice for viewers

programme.title: Crimewatch Live

programme.title: Mod 2026
programme.desc: Cathy MacDonald presents live coverage of the most prestigious choral competitions from the last day of the Royal National Mòd in Glasgow. Area choirs will gather in the Glasgow Royal Concert Hall to compete for the Lovat and Tullibardine Shield which was won by Glasgow Gaelic Musical Association in Lochaber in 2025. Running alongside is the competition for the Margrat Duncan Memorial Trophy, won last year by Lochaber Gaelic Choir. Cathy will be joined in the studio by two expert panelists who will offer analysis of both competitions. The programme will also feature winners of the morning’s choral competitions which included the Greenock Gaelic Choir Cup for puirt-à-beul and the Esme Smythe Trophy for ladies voices

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc:
Latha trang eile aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche le Ciorstaidh an Loiliopop a' lìbhrigeadh Là Sàbhailteachd Rathaid agus Danny an Janny trang le Là Sàbhailteachd Teine. Bidh na camarathan againne a' leantainn a h-uile rud a thachras tron latha.

programme.title: Clo Beag Chirsty Bella
programme.desc:
Tha Chirsty Bella ag iarraidh Clò Hearach a dhèanamh...tha e gu math nas fhasa smaoineachadh air sin na tha e ga chuir an gnìomh. Tha ì a' fuireach ann an Scalpaigh, Na Hearadh. Tha gaol aice air a h-eilean agus tha ì ga cumail fhèin trang le bhith a reic uighean agus a dèanamh dannsa Gàidheallach. 'S toigh leatha cuideachd an clò ainmeil clùiteach: Clò Hearach. Tha an t-seann bheairt mar time machine, ga toirt air ais gu lìnn an fhearsaid, nan càrd, 's a spàl. An teid orra à clò a dhèanamh ann an àm?
Chirsty Bella wants to produce her own Harris tweed but that is easier said than done. She lives in Scalpay, a little village in the Isle of Harris, loves her island and keeps herself going through little jobs like selling eggs and traditional Scottish Highland dancing. She also loves the famous and traditional fabric: Harris Tweed. The original Harris Tweed loom is like a time machine that takes her back over a hundred years to the age of spindles, combs and shuttles. Will she manage to weave her cloth in time?

programme.title: Cù Leis Thu? (A Puppy for Pàdruig)
programme.desc: Peter MacQueen considers the labrador retriever and sets out to uncover why it's Scotland's most popular breed. His first stop is a farm in Stirlingshire, where he learns about the labrador's origins as a skilled retriever, bred for fetching game from water. Eager to see these dogs in action, Peter heads to South Uist in the Outer Hebrides. Joining a shooting party before sunrise, he watches in awe as labradors plunge into cold waters, retrieving geese with ease and agility. Later, he visits Glasgow to meet some working guide dogs, discovering the breed's gentle, intelligent, and dependable qualities

programme.title: Mod 2026
programme.desc: Cathy Macdonald brings this year’s coverage of the Royal National Mòd in Glasgow to a close with highlights from the choral competitions held over the last two days. Amongst the performances featured will be songs from the choirs who successfully competed for the two main prizes for the area choirs, the Lovat and Tullibardine Shield and the Margrat Duncan Memorial Trophy. Also featured will be a selection winners from the rural choirs competitions, including those who clinched the coveted Lorn Shield and the Sheriff MacMaster Campbell Memorial Quaich. In addition to the choirs there will also be another opportunity to hear the talented solo singers who took home the An Comunn Gàidhealach Gold Medal and the Gold Medal for traditional singing

programme.title: The Devil's Confession - The Lost Eichmann Tapes
programme.desc: Part one of two. Escaping from postwar Europe, Nazi war criminal Adolf Eichmann established a new life in Argentina, where he met Dutch journalist and fellow Nazi Willem Sassen. In Buenos Aires in 1957, they recorded a comprehensive account of his career, but the tapes disappeared when Eichmann was captured and taken to stand trial in Jerusalem. Excerpts of his interview surfaced in Life magazine, and Israeli prosecutor Gideon Hausner was determined to use Eichmann's recorded confession as evidence during the trial

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Florence Headlam and Sue Kent are in Stevenage to help mother and daughter Margaret and Elizabeth transform their south-facing garden into a serene, shaded relaxation space

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Friends Louise, Mark, Suzy and Rich compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Game show, hosted by Ross Kemp

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon journeys deep into Canada's vast and empty Yukon Territory, one of North America's most remote landscapes. Covering an area almost the size of Spain but home to fewer than 50,000 people, the Yukon is a land of immense forests, glaciers, rivers and wildlife. Simon wants to find out how the people and the wildlife of this immense wilderness are faring, all while searching for grizzly bears

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle down the Answer Run towards them. programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael concludes his journey from Cumbria to Dumfries and Galloway by crossing the Solway Firth, where he visits the last home of Scotland's Bard Robert Burns. Further north into the Lowther Hills, Michael strikes gold in the rich geological landscape around Wanlockhead, Scotland's highest village, and rides a charming heritage industrial railway across the stunning terrain. His journey ends at the spectacular Palladian mansion of Dumfries House, home to a world-class Chippendale furniture collection and the headquarters of the King's Foundation

programme.title: The Great House Revival
programme.desc: Dublin-based architects Fiona Brugha and Paddy Dunne convert a derelict cowshed belonging to the vast Rockingham Estate in the dense forest of Lough Key. The pair plan to turn the thick stone walled ruin into a contemporary family home for themselves and their two small children. Their budget is €350,000, but a restoration project among the trees doesn't come without challenges

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie Vipond visits the Sheep Dog World Trial at Lauder in the Scottish Borders, finding out how the family hosting the event turned their working farm into a championship venue and meeting some of the international competitors and their dogs taking part. Rosie Morton is on Bute for a trialling masterclass from one of the sport's best handlers, while Cammy Wilson is at the Kelso Ram Sales investigating the continuing decline in sheep numbers in Scotland. Anne Lundon visits a craftswoman keeping the tradition of crook-making alive

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is tackling jobs in the autumn garden and introduces plants that keep colour and interest going for as long as possible. programme.title: Six Wives with Lucy Worsley
programme.desc: Lucy talks about the impact of Anne Boleyn on Henry VIII's affections, uncovering private moments that were reported by eyewitnesses or recorded in historical documents. The key moments during their marriage are recreated, as Anne falls from favour in court and is eventually executed, despite protestations of innocence regarding the rumours of her infidelity. As soon as Anne is dead, Henry marries Jane Seymour, who fulfils her most important role as Queen - giving birth to the healthy son that Henry has craved for so long

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: Classic psychological thriller starring Jodie Foster and Anthony Hopkins. Promising FBI student Clarice Starling is assigned to help in the search for the serial killer known as "Buffalo Bill", a brutal murderer who skins the bodies of his female victims. Starling seeks the assistance of Dr Hannibal "the Cannibal" Lecter, a sociopathic former psychiatrist held in a maximum security hospital for the criminally insane.

High-school nerd Denis Cooverman chooses his graduation speech to finally declare his love for gorgeous cheerleader Beth Cooper and, to everyone's surprise, she isn't entirely repulsed. But with Beth's ex-boyfriend refusing to accept that their relationship is over, Paul becomes a marked man.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Drama starring Chris Evans. Frank has raised his niece Mary, a maths prodigy, to be as "normal" as possible. Then Mary's snobbish grandmother suddenly arrives, sparking a difficult custody battle.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Daisy Ridley. Born in New York in 1905, Trudy Ederle survives childhood illness and goes on to defy societal norms by pursuing her passion for swimming. After achieving success in local competitions, she decides to take on her biggest challenge: swimming across the English Channel.

programme.title: The Aristocats
programme.desc: Classic Disney animated adventure featuring the voices of Phil Harris and Eva Gabor. A mother cat and her kittens who stand to inherit the fortune of an eccentric Parisian opera singer are dumped in the countryside by the woman's butler in a bid to cheat them out of their money. In their effort to get home, they are assisted by a tough alley cat and an assortment of unlikely allies.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: A re-imagining of the Sleeping Beauty fairy tale, told from the perspective of its villain, played by Angelina Jolie. When her childhood sweetheart, Stefan, betrays her in order to claim the crown of a neighbouring kingdom, Maleficent the fairy swears she will have revenge. She gets her chance when Stefan has a daughter named Aurora, and Maleficent curses the infant to fall into an eternal sleep on her 16th birthday.

programme.title: Treasure Planet
programme.desc: Animated science-fiction adventure based on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel, Treasure Island. When a pirate treasure map falls into the hands of young tearaway Jim Hawkins, he is determined to find the fabled loot. Joining a space galleon as a cabin boy, he sets off on an intergalactic voyage of discovery, under the watchful eye of mysterious cyborg cook John Silver.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure sequel starring Ben Barnes, Georgie Henley, William Moseley, Anna Popplewell and Skandar Keynes. Summoned back to Narnia by the beleaguered Prince Caspian, the Pevensie children join the struggle to deliver the magical kingdom from the dark forces of the tyrannical Lord Miraz.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Dave Foley and Kevin Spacey. When daydreaming ant Flik accidentally puts his colony in peril from a swarm of warlike grasshoppers, led by the ruthless Hopper, he sets off for the big city to win even tougher bugs over to the ants' cause.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: For centuries, people have called out to the universe looking for answers. In this fun-filled, action-packed feature film from Disney and Pixar, the universe calls back! The cosmic adventure introduces Elio, a space fanatic with an active imagination and a huge alien obsession. So, when he's beamed up to the Communiverse, an interplanetary organization with representatives from galaxies far and wide, Elio's all in for the epic undertaking. Mistakenly identified as Earth's leader, Elio must form new bonds with eccentric alien life-forms, navigate a crisis of intergalactic proportions, and somehow discover who and where he is truly meant to be.

programme.title: George of the Jungle
programme.desc: Comedy adventure starring Brendan Fraser. When his plane crashes in the African jungle, infant George is discovered and raised by gorillas. Years later, San Francisco heiress Ursula Stanhope arrives in the jungle on safari, followed by her obnoxious fiancé Lyle, who is intent on tracking down the legendary "white ape" - none other than George himself. Having rescued Ursula from a lion, George develops unaccustomed feelings for her, while Lyle and his poacher companions have a more selfish agenda.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Robert Downey Jr, Gwyneth Paltrow and Jeff Bridges. Billionaire playboy Tony Stark is an industrialist and munitions genius who's out in Afghanistan to demonstrate a new missile system, when he and his military escort are attacked by rebels. Though badly injured, Stark is captured and forced to manufacture a weapon. But with the help of a fellow imprisoned scientist, Stark instead builds an armoured suit that will see the tycoon take on the identity of superhero Iron Man.

programme.title: The Rare Breed
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart and Maureen O'Hara. When Martha Price arrives in America from Britain, she brings with her a young daughter and an animal she hopes will make her fortune: Vindicator, a prize Hereford bull. She finds the Texas ranchers sceptical and Sam Burnett, the saddle tramp hired to deliver the bull to his new home, seems to be neither honest nor reliable.

Using scientific knowledge, ingenuity and drawing on seemingly inexhaustible levels of resolve, Mark must find a way to survive long enough to be rescued.

programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands
programme.desc: Sam Neill narrates the story of some of New Zealand's wildest places, home to hyper-intelligent parrots, snails with teeth, and constellations of glow-worms. In these often inhospitable locations, any creature hoping to survive must resort to radical techniques, none more so than on the South Island, which lies toward Antarctica and is home to the rapidly rising peaks of the Southern Alps

programme.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands
programme.desc: New Zealand is now home to some of the richest agricultural land in the world, boasting magnificent gardens with plants from around the planet and rare magical creatures. programme.desc: Supernatural horror comedy starring Marianne Jean-Baptiste and Hayley Squires. Recently divorced Sheila is looking for a dress to impress, and happens upon a striking red gown that she quickly snaps up. When Sheila finds herself caught up in strange and increasingly dangerous events, though, the culprit may well be the mysterious, malevolent garment.

programme.title: Roman Abramovich: How He Hid His Fortune - Panorama
programme.desc: A look at Russian billionaire Roman Abramovich's financial dealings, with new evidence from an offshore data leak suggesting his business empire was built on lies. Working with the Bureau of Investigative Journalism, Panorama has uncovered hundreds of documents that appear to have been falsified and backdated to conceal his vast fortune. Richard Bilton investigates Abramovich's suspect paperwork and the big accountancy firm that signed off his misleading accounts

programme.title: Time
programme.desc: A tragedy strikes in a young offenders' institution. Return of Jimmy McGovern's prison anthology drama

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris find a skeleton buried in the ice and think it’s an ancient ancestor. But after a series of strange discoveries, things take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Dad gets a severe case of Proximan hiccups. Big Lizard and Cosima do their best to help, but their attempt to scare Dad goes wrong when a real 'monster' turns up!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy teams up with the cheating Chipmunk to win a game of basketball

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes are questing to find out who is behind a string of cake thefts, and go into detective mode. After questioning the baker, they decide to stage a stakeout at the bakery. However, when they spy cakes apparently walking off by themselves, they realise that there is more to this mystery than meets the eye - and a quest to find some missing cakes soon turns into a quest to save the entire forest!

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a silkworm.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is a ball boy at an important tennis match, but Frog causes chaos by accidentally filling the automatic ball launcher with oranges that splat the crowd!

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: Rising Hope
programme.desc: The Rising Volt Tacklers meet up with new and old friends at Blueberry Academy

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: Following an accident, Tecna's magic is short-circuited, forcing her come to terms with her emotions. The Winx and the Specialists take her to her home world of Zenith to be repaired.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Talented spaniels and one of the strongest women in the world attempt to smash world records in the studio, while Shini tries to clean the windows of the tallest building in the UK

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: Current affairs reports aimed at a younger audience

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Anita Rani and Sean Fletcher head to the South Pennines to join archaeologists and conservationists uncovering the remarkable ways peat is preserving the past while helping to protect the future. Meanwhile, John Craven reveals the winner of this year's Countryfile Photography Competition, for Children in Need

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Frances Tophill is tackling jobs in the autumn garden and introduces plants that keep colour and interest going for as long as possible. Jamie Butterworth delves into the fascinating world of shade-loving plants, and Ashley Edwards joins sound artist Jason Singh for an unusual journey through the garden, Plus, A couple have designed a garden around an elaborate miniature railway

programme.title: World Track Cycling Championships 2026
programme.desc: Clare Balding presents coverage of the fourth and penultimate day of the event, which takes place at Shanghai Velodrome, China. Medals are awarded in the women's madison and individual pursuit in this event last year, and Great Britain won both disciplines last year in Santiago, with the duo of Katie Archibald and Madelaine Leech taking victory in the former, and Anna Morris beating compatriot Josie Knight into second place in the latter. With analysis from Laura Kenny

programme.title: North by Northwest
programme.desc: Classic spy thriller starring Cary Grant, Eva Marie Saint and James Mason. Advertising executive Roger Thornhill finds his life in deadly peril when he is mistaken for the mysterious "Mr Kaplan" by ruthless members of an enemy spy network. Failing to convince them of his identity, Thornhill tracks down the one man who can prove his story only to find himself accused of murder.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team value antiques at the Museum of Science and Industry in Manchester. Experts Anita Manning and Michael Baggott inspect some high-quality Danish silver, and a pot of gold. Meanwhile, Paul is taken on an architectural tour of the city, and examines a replica of the first-ever computer

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon journeys deep into Canada's vast and empty Yukon Territory, one of North America's most remote landscapes. Covering an area almost the size of Spain but home to fewer than 50,000 people, the Yukon is a land of immense forests, glaciers, rivers and wildlife. Simon wants to find out how the people and the wildlife of this immense wilderness are faring, all while searching for grizzly bears

programme.title: Where Eagles Dare
programme.desc: Second World War action written by Alistair MacLean and starring Richard Burton and Clint Eastwood as members of an elite group of commandos who must enter an almost impregnable Nazi stronghold to rescue a high ranking American officer.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1986 at the BBC
programme.desc: A selection of archive performances from the year, featuring A Different Corner by George Michael, Simply Red's Holding Back the Years, Touch Me by Samantha Fox and Jermaine Stewart's We Don't Have to Take Our Clothes Off. Plus, appearances by Pet Shop Boys, A-ha, Eurythmics, Erasure, Nick Berry, Falco, Nana Mouskouri and Europe

programme.title: TOTP 1986: Big Hits
programme.desc: A look back at some of the records that dominated the year, featuring songs by Bon Jovi, Cyndi Lauper, Cameo, the Pretenders, the Real Thing, Billy Ocean and the Communards. Other highlights include the Housemartins, Kim Wilde, the Human League and the Cure

programme.title: Top of the Pops: The Story of 1986
programme.desc: A look back at the year when Simply Red, the Housemartins, Sinitta, the Communards and Swing Out Sister hit the charts. It was a time that saw the advent of house music, the big bang in the money markets and political fatigue on the left. How did these real-world events make their mark on the nation's most popular show?

programme.title: Grimsburg
programme.desc: Marvin intervenes when Stan receives an alarming superlative, while Wynona undergoes a brain procedure to improve her dating life away from work

programme.title: Grimm
programme.desc: Juliette regains the last of her memories and wants to get back together with Nick, whose latest case uncovers a plot to create an army of zombies. Adalind makes a dangerous bargain with Stefania to regain her supernatural powers - in exchange for her unborn child

programme.title: Evil
programme.desc: Kristen, David, and Ben investigate a suspected werewolf attack. Andy deals with unexplained trauma.

programme.title: Hawaii Five-0
programme.desc: The team investigates when a simmering gang war spills over at a high-school football game, and uncovers an unlikely partnership between Samoan gangs and the Mob. Danny has issues with his ex-wife when she threatens to cut off his custody rights, but the situation improves when McGarrett calls in a favour from a powerful ally

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: When Hicks witnesses the assassination of an old friend hwo is a prominent judge, the team races to find the shooter and determine why he was targeted. Luca struggles over how best to help his brother after Terry is arrested

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: When a plane carrying Street and the dangerous prisoner he is transporting is hijacked, the team races to save the innocent passengers on board - and one of their own. Meanwhile, Hondo take a big step in his relationship with Nichelle.

programme.title: Dragon Rider
programme.desc: A silver dragon named Firedrake and his friends search for a mythical safe haven hidden in the Himalayas. Animated family adventure based on the novel by Cornelia Funke, featuring the voices of Felicity Jones, Thomas Brodie-Sangster, Patrick Stewart and Freddie Highmore

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist and film-maker explores the many varieties of plant life housed at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, and explains what they reveal about the natural world and the development of life on Earth. He begins inside the establishment's Palm House, whose climate has been engineered to simulate conditions found in rainforests, charting the evolution of plants that grow in the world's wettest regions and investigating how flowering plants spread across the globe so rapidly

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist explores how the plants at Kew Gardens change through the seasons and demonstrates the surprising properties of several species, including the predatory pond-dwelling bladderwort utricularia and a fungus that appears to be capable of mind control. He also discusses the largest single organism on the planet, visits the world's biggest flower and explains how plants and insects can communicate using scents and music

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his exploration of the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, by examining plants that have evolved to minimise their dependence on water, enabling them to survive in the world's driest environments. He witnesses a cactus blooming at midnight, tells the story of the spectacular flowering of the Agave franzosinii, and visits the Millennium Seed Bank, a facility designed to save plants from future extinction

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Jonah encourages Amy to have a small baby shower in order to stock up on much-needed baby supplies, but things quickly get out of hand. Meanwhile, Mateo art directs the photo shoot for Dina's Christmas card

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Amy (America Ferrera) and Jonah (Ben Feldman) get combative to keep their new relationship hidden from their co-workers. programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: When an employee costume competition is announced, Amy (America Ferrera) and Mateo (Nico Santos) aren't afraid to play dirty to win first prize - a paid day off. programme.desc: Amy (America Ferrera) faces a nightmare day at work when she learns she doesn't have maternity leave - made worse by Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom) and Mateo's (Nico Santos) campaign to change her baby's name. programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First into the barn, for the attention of silversmith Brenton West, is a small metal statue that once stood proudly in the garden of Helen Elverstone's grandparents. Now the human figure has broken in two, with one leg still embedded in rock while the rest of the body has snapped off at the waist. After Helen's grandparents died, the statue went to live in her mum's garden, and Helen has fond memories of times sat talking with her mum in her special place - the garden - next to the statue. Sadly, just after the death of her mother, Helen found the statue lying broken on the ground. Now she hopes Brenton can piece this little part of her family history back together again.
Next, horologist Steve Fletcher has his skills tested by a timepiece all the way from Trinidad. Sashtee Tirbhowen's clock has been in her family for four generations, and she remembers being woken by the clock every morning. The clock survived the long journey to England, but it didn't fare so well after a leak brought a ceiling down on top of it. Sashtee couldn't forgive herself for the damage to her dad's precious clock, and is hoping Steve can help her make amends by getting it working once again.
Amanda Anderson arrives with a painting of her grandmother at the age of 19, and a tale of long-lost love, for art conservator Lucia Scalisi. The artist was also her grandmother's first love, but when the slightly older artist approached her father for her hand in marriage, he was refused. Amanda was very close to her grandmother, who continued to be a part of the Glasgow art scene, and on her death the portrait passed to Amanda. But now the glamorous figure in the painting is being let down by the condition of the canvas and the frame. It's down to Lucia to restore the painting to its former glory.

programme.title: The Repair Shop

programme.title: The Repair Shop

This vintage radiogram belongs to Clifton Smith and was once the pride and joy of his parents, providing the soundtrack to many happy family events. The last time Clifton heard it playing properly was at a party the night before he joined the army at the age of 16 over 40 years ago. Now he is pinning his hopes on Mark's electrical know-how to get it spinning discs once again.
Lydia Lewis is the next arrival, with a tricky little trinket for horologist Steve Fletcher. It is a mid-20th-century treasure that used to grace her grandmother's drinks trolley. It looks like a vintage telephone, but the base contains a hidden musical box that plays when the receiver is lifted, while the receiver itself cleverly conceals a lighter. Though her grandmother died before she was born, Lydia loves the telephone and would like to see it working again as it did when her grandmother was alive. Steve's challenge is to fix the lighter mechanism and repair the broken mouthpiece.
Finally, the perfect job for master saddlemaker Suzie Fletcher - a saddle. But Elana Beavis's saddle is no ordinary saddle. It travelled around Canada with her great-grandparents after they quit farming in England for a new life across the Atlantic running a rodeo. After many adventures, the family eventually moved back to the UK, with the elaborate saddle being one of the few possessions they just couldn't leave behind. Now Lydia would like to restore the worn-out leather work as a tribute to her intrepid ancestors.
