Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Jaws
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic adventure thriller, starring Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw and Richard Dreyfuss. The Atlantic resort of Amity Island is preparing for its lucrative summer season when death strikes in the form of a Great White shark. Rather than turn away business, Mayor Vaughn orders police chief Brody to keep the beaches open.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: Crime thriller starring Clint Eastwood. San Francisco cop "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned the case of a sniper who has murdered a young girl and threatened further killings if his ransom demand is not met. Dismayed to find himself partnered with a raw recruit, Callahan is soon at odds with his bosses over whether to pay off the killer.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Cold War action thriller starring Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin and Scott Glenn. The trial voyage of new Soviet submarine Red October does not go as expected. Equipped with an experimental new propulsion system that makes it virtually impossible to track and captained by the enigmatic Marko Ramius, the heavily armed vessel heads for America. Is Ramius about to launch an undetectable, pre-emptive nuclear strike?

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: Suspense thriller starring Morgan Freeman. Following the abduction of a senator's daughter, psychological profiler Alex Cross is forced to join the hunt when he's contacted by the kidnapper. Working closely with the agent responsible for security at the girl's school, Cross uncovers a disturbing conspiracy.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Heist thriller based on a true story, starring Jason Statham and Saffron Burrows. In 1970s London, Terry Leather, a car dealer with a dubious past, is approached by his glamorous former girlfriend Martine. She has a plan to steal safe deposit boxes from a top bank, and needs his help to organise the robbery. But the boxes contain more than just valuables, and Terry discovers that several dangerous individuals also want to get hold of them.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Political thriller starring Harrison Ford and Willem Dafoe. When Jack Ryan is asked to investigate the murder of a friend of the US President, he finds himself up against not only a Colombian drugs cartel but also corrupt American government officials.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Sequel to Steven Spielberg's blockbuster, starring Roy Scheider as police chief Martin Brody, who fears that a great white shark is once again threatening the holiday resort of Amity. But with the summer season under way, Brody has a tough job convincing Amity's business community of the danger.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Titane
programme.desc: Psychological horror drama starring Agathe Rousselle and Vincent Lindon. After committing a string of brutal murders, car showroom dancer Alexia goes on the run. Shaving her head and breaking her nose to hide her identity, she poses as the long-absent son of kindly firefighter Vincent. But with a miraculous pregnancy beginning to show, Alexia can only keep up her ruse for so long.

programme.title: Gunman's Walk
programme.desc: Western starring Van Heflin and Tab Hunter. Growing up in the shadow of former gunslinger Lee Hackett is a tough proposition for his sons Ed and Davy. While Davy looks for love, Ed's explosive temperament threatens to destroy everything his father has built.

programme.title: Living Interview Special
programme.desc: Bill Nighy, writer Kazuo Ishiguro and director Oliver Hermanus talk about making their beautiful and melancholy new drama

programme.title: Written on the Wind
programme.desc: Melodrama starring Rock Hudson, Lauren Bacall and Robert Stack. When Lucy Moore falls in love with the handsome son of a Texas millionaire, her life is transformed. But Kyle Hadley is a tormented man with a secret that not even Moore can discover until it's too late.

programme.title: Man in the Saddle
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott and Joan Leslie. Wealthy Will Isham is determined to destroy rancher Owen Merritt, worried that he may make off with his wife, Leslie, who is obviously smitten by him.

programme.title: The War Wagon
programme.desc: Western starring John Wayne and Kirk Douglas. Taw Jackson and Lomax are two rivals who decide to bury the hatchet when Jackson is released from jail on parole. They plan to rob the greedy mine owner who put Jackson behind bars but they have to contend with the "war wagon", the mine owner's ingenious way of protecting his gold.

programme.title: My Stepmother Is an Alien
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dan Aykroyd and Kim Basinger. When widowed scientist Steven Mills inadvertently makes contact with a far-off planet, the beautiful Celeste is sent to Earth to locate the man who could be the key to saving her alien civilisation.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

programme.title: Midnight Run
programme.desc: Comedy thriller starring Robert De Niro and Charles Grodin. Bounty hunter Jack Walsh is just the man to bring embezzler Jonathan "The Duke" Mardukas to justice. Down on his luck, the $100,000 fee is just what Jack needs right now. The only problem is that Mardukas cheated the Mafia out of a cool $15 million, and they want their money back. Can Jack beat the FBI and an unscrupulous rival to his quarry?

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Men In Black Films
programme.desc: A look at the blockbusting fantasy comedies, starring Will Smith, Tommy Lee Jones and more

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Futuristic sci-fi thriller starring Harrison Ford and Ryan Gosling. Los Angeles blade runner Officer K uncovers a shocking secret that puts him on the trail of Rick Deckard, who has been missing for 30 years. Meanwhile, corporate magnate Niander Wallace seeks the truth about so-called replicant reproduction in order to further his plans for interstellar colonisation.

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: Sci-fi satire starring Robert Pattinson. Desperate to escape loan sharks on Earth, Mickey Barnes enlists as an "expendable", a job that sees him getting killed and reincarnated repeatedly while undertaking dangerous tasks for an interplanetary colony ship overseen by a demagogue politician. When the 17th Mickey survives a deadly mission and returns to discover Mickey 18 is already in existence, trouble starts to brew.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller starring Jennifer Lawrence. In annual retribution for a failed uprising in the totalitarian state of Panem, each of 12 districts is forced to select a young boy and girl to take part in a televised fight to the death. When her younger sister is chosen, the resourceful Katniss Everdeen volunteers to take her place.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: James Cameron's science-fiction action thriller sequel to The Terminator, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Linda Hamilton. Tormented by the imminent threat of a nuclear holocaust from which intelligent machines will emerge to crush the last vestiges of human existence, Sarah Connor has been institutionalised and separated from her son. Informed of the future, she knows that young John Connor will survive and become leader of the human race. However, the machines of 2029 know it too, and once again they send a cyborg assassin back through time to terminate the potential saviour.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: The second part of the futuristic action adventure based on the novels by Suzanne Collins, starring Jennifer Lawrence. programme.desc:
The Twirlywoos watch a musician playing a drum kit. He starts out playing softly, and gets louder until the Twirlywoos have to cover their ears. When he leaves, the Twirlywoos come out and start to investigate the drums. Chickedy and Chick jump on the snare drums, Great BigHoo steps on the bass pedal, and Toodloo dances on the cymbals. As they get carried away, they play louder and louder, until they're making an almighty racket! The Hooter calls them home just as the musician returns, and he's surprised to find his cymbals still swinging.
Peekaboo has found a shell to use as a trumpet, but can only get a tiny squeak out of it. When the Twirlywoos return, Peekaboo leaves the shell and rushes back to the hole in the wall. Chickedy and Chick try blowing into the shell, but they can only make a small noise. Toodloo tries and manages to make it a bit louder. Then Great BigHoo has a go and makes a loud trumpeting sound. The Hooter responds with a loud honk of its own, and the two compete to see who can make the loudest noise.

The slide engulfed a school and neighbouring homes, claiming the lives of 116 children and 28 adults in a disaster that shocked the world, but the story of what followed has been largely forgotten. programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring David Oyelowo and Tom Wilkinson. Alabama, 1965: although segregation in the United States is supposed to have ended, equal votes for black people in the Deep South is still not a reality. Nobel prize-winning civil rights leader Dr Martin Luther King meets with President Lyndon B Johnson and asks him to act, but when Johnson stalls, Dr King goes to Selma, Alabama, and initiates a series of demonstrations and marches that will change the face of America.

He also investigates the rich heritage of the Black Country in Wolverhampton with a lesson in 'yam yam'. In Coseley, Michael discovers that one of the area's most successful industries, brickmaking, continues at Ketley Brick

programme.title: Gymnastics: World Championships 2026
programme.desc: Live coverage of the men's team final, held this year at Rotterdam Ahoy, the Netherlands. Last year's championships did not feature team competitions, as is the norm the year after an Olympic Games, so this event last featured three years ago in Antwerp. A Japan team spearheaded by Daiki Hashimoto, who won two more golds, were victorious on that occasion, with China finishing second and USA claiming bronze

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: When a surfer is left paralysed by a wave, the Appledore crew are tasked with an immediate launch. It soon becomes clear that the casualty has been saved from drowning by a teenage boy. In Little and Broad Haven, south Wales, there's a frantic search for two paddleboarders swept over a mile out to sea. Also, the Hayling Island crew race against time to rescue a fisherman trapped in mud

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Analysis of the day's events, with Paddy O'Connell

programme.title: Aberfan: The Village That Fought Back
programme.desc: The catastrophic collapse in 1966 of a coal-waste tip above the south Wales village of Aberfan remains one of the most devastating tragedies in modern British history. The slide engulfed a school and neighbouring homes, claiming the lives of 116 children and 28 adults in a disaster that shocked the world, but the story of what followed has been largely forgotten. Marking the 60th anniversary, this documentary uncovers the little-told story of the extraordinary campaign that emerged in the disaster's aftermath, revealing how a shattered village rose from unimaginable grief to demand justice, challenged the most powerful institutions in Britain, and forced the removal of the coal tips that still loomed above their homes

programme.desc:
There's a treat in store for metalworker Dominic Chinea when he comes face to face with a one-of-a-kind bicycle sidecar, designed for junior passengers. Owners Chrissy and Steve have many fond memories of peddling around town with their three children in tow, but the ingenious contraption is now dilapidated after being exiled to the shed for decades.
Furniture restorer Will Kirk is presented with the dreaded box of bits when he meets the owner of what was a Victorian sewing table. And percussion expert Pete Woods restores a piece of military history - a drum that saw frontline action in both world wars. The drum belonged to owner Tim's grandfather, who signed up for duty in the Royal Fusiliers at just thirteen years of age. Too young to be a soldier, Tim's grandad became a drummer boy and would accompany marching soldiers.

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with a 1936 edition of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo ventures onto the European rail network, beginning an emotional rail journey which takes him deep into his family's past. In the golden city of Salamanca in northwestern Spain, Michael visits the University to hear of opposition to the fascist takeover of Spain by General Francisco Franco, and gains access to the General's archive of enemies of the state. Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Michael's final stop is on the border with France at Canfranc station, where he learns of the role the old terminus played in the evacuation of Jews during the Second World War

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo travels from the chateaux of the Loire Valley to the heart of the Champagne region at Reims, beginning in the city of Orleans in north-central France. Here, he follows his Bradshaw's guide to the magnificent stained-glass windows of the Cathedral of Sainte-Croix, which tell the story of the heroine of France, Joan of Arc. Later, Michael takes a spin around the track at Le Mans in a French-built car, before making his way to the capital city of Paris. East of Paris, Michael finishes this leg of his journey in style with a tour of the cellars at Domaine Pommery in Reims

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures on a rail journey through Germany, guided by Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide published in 1936. Starting in the vibrant city of Berlin, Michael visits the Museum of Modern Art in Berlin's Kreuzberg, where he sees how a leading artist of the era, George Grosz, warned of the rise of fascism in a haunting self-portrait. In the Schöneberg district of the capital, Michael researches the decadent night scene of the 1920s, and looks at how cabaret culture is being revived today. When he reaches Weimar, Michael investigates the beginnings of Bauhaus design and visits the movement's first building, before travelling onto Stuttgart, where he takes a ride in a high-performance Porsche to the manufacturer's Stuttgart headquarters

programme.title: Rise of the Nazis: The Manhunt
programme.desc: After the Nuremberg trial, the most senior ranking Nazis had been executed or imprisoned - but many of the worst criminals were still at large. They included Adolf Eichmann, who arranged the transportation of millions of Europe's Jewish people to death camps, and Nazi secret police chief Klaus Barbie, who became known as 'the Butcher of Lyon' because of his reputation for extreme cruelty. This documentary follows the hunt for these two war criminals

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

Among the items brought in to be valued are a delicate Chinese lantern, a collection of jewellery and a rare book signed by JRR Tolkien

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents the show from Helmingham Hall, a Tudor manor house with two working drawbridges in Suffolk. programme.title: Only Fools and Horses
programme.desc: The Trotters go on a lads' day out to Margate with their mates, but things do not go as expected when their bus blows up, leaving them stranded overnight in the seaside town. Finding a room in the hotel from hell, the brothers are only too happy to go out and sample the local nightlife - and that's when Del-Boy gets a blast from the past. Feature-length Christmas special from 1989, starring David Jason and Nicholas Lyndhurst

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses
programme.desc: The Trotters meet a pregnant German woman who is in need of help, so eternal optimist Del-Boy becomes her saviour, aiming to earn himself some money into the bargain by making Marlene and Boycie's dreams come true. Comedy, starring David Jason, Nicholas Lyndhurst, Buster Merryfield and John Challis

programme.title: The Story of Only Fools and Horses
programme.desc: Definitive documentary series about the sitcom classic. This time, find out about the process behind each episode, including unseen footage.

programme.title: My Family
programme.desc: The Harpers go their separate ways after a big argument. While Ben moves in with Roger - much to the dismay of his friend, who is expecting a date - Susan throws a party to celebrate her new-found freedom. However, anything she can do, he can do better, and the dentist sets about faking his own party to make his wife jealous. Zoe Wanamaker and Robert Lindsay star as the warring couple, with Doreen Mantle (One Foot in the Grave)

programme.title: My Family
programme.desc: Kenzo's father asks for Janey's hand in marriage, but she is already smitten with good-looking Australian Craig - and Susan is thrilled to learn he is also planning a proposal

programme.title: My Family
programme.desc: Ben is outraged by the introduction of timecards at work, so he takes a stand by forming a union - but his boss Mr Griffith responds by making him a tempting offer. programme.title: Tipping Point
programme.desc: Ben Shephard hosts the quiz in which contestants answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: DIY SOS: The Big Build
